title: Delete ACL Rule
description: Deletes an access control rule from a Google Calendar. Use when you need to remove sharing permissions for a user, group, or domain.

required.name: rule_id
required.description: ACL rule identifier.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.

title: Get ACL Rule
description: Retrieves a specific access control rule for a calendar. Use when you need to check permissions for a specific user, group, or domain.

required.name: rule_id
required.description: ACL rule identifier. Format: 'scope_type:scope_value' or 'default'. Valid scope types: 'user' (email), 'group' (group email), 'domain' (domain name), 'default' (public access). Examples: 'user:john@example.com', 'group:team@example.com', 'domain:example.com', 'default'. Note: 'me' is NOT valid; use actual email/domain. The rule must exist - use GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_ACL_RULES to find valid IDs.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.

title: Create ACL Rule
description: Creates an access control rule for a calendar. Use when you need to grant sharing permissions to a user, group, or domain.

required.name: role
required.description: The role assigned to the scope. Possible values: "none" - Provides no access; "freeBusyReader" - Provides read access to free/busy information; "reader" - Provides read access to the calendar; "writer" - Provides read and write access to the calendar; "owner" - Provides ownership of the calendar.

required.name: scope
required.description: The extent to which calendar access is granted by this ACL rule. Specifies who gets the access (user, group, domain, or default).

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.

optional.name: send_notifications
optional.description: Whether to send notifications about the calendar sharing change. Optional. The default is true.

title: List ACL Rules
description: Retrieves the list of access control rules (ACLs) for a specified calendar, providing the necessary 'rule_id' values required for updating specific ACL rules.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.

optional.name: page_token
optional.description: Token specifying which result page to return. Optional.

optional.name: sync_token
optional.description: Token obtained from the nextSyncToken field returned on the last page of a previous list operation. It makes the result of this list operation contain only entries that have changed since then. Optional. The default is to retrieve all entries.

optional.name: max_results
optional.description: Maximum number of entries returned on one result page. Optional. The default is 100.

optional.name: show_deleted
optional.description: Whether to include deleted ACLs in the result. Optional. The default is False.

title: Patch ACL Rule
description: Updates an existing access control rule for a calendar using patch semantics (partial update). This allows modifying specific fields without affecting other properties. IMPORTANT: The ACL rule must already exist on the calendar. This action cannot create new rules. If you receive a 404 Not Found error, the rule does not exist - use ACL insert to create it first, or use ACL list to verify available rules. Each patch request consumes three quota units. For domain-type ACL rules, if PATCH fails with 500 error, this action will automatically fallback to UPDATE method.

required.name: rule_id
required.description: ACL rule identifier of an existing rule. IMPORTANT: The rule must already exist on the calendar - this action cannot create new rules, only modify existing ones. Use the ACL list action to find existing rule IDs, or use the ACL insert action to create a new rule first. Format: 'type:value', such as 'user:email@example.com' or 'group:group@example.com'.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.

optional.name: role
optional.description: The role assigned to the scope. Possible values are: "none" - Provides no access; "freeBusyReader" - Provides read access to free/busy information; "reader" - Provides read access to the calendar (private events appear but details are hidden); "writer" - Provides read and write access to the calendar (private events and details are visible); "owner" - Provides ownership of the calendar (all permissions of writer plus ability to see and manipulate ACLs).

optional.name: scope
optional.description: The extent to which calendar access is granted by this ACL rule. Optional for patch operations. Must include `type` (one of: 'user', 'group', 'domain', 'default') and `value` (email address or domain name) for all types except 'default'.

optional.name: send_notifications
optional.description: Whether to send notifications about the calendar sharing change. Note that there are no notifications on access removal. Optional. The default is True.

title: Update ACL Rule
description: Updates an access control rule for the specified calendar.

required.name: role
required.description:
The role assigned to the scope. Possible values are: 
- "none" - Provides no access. 
- "freeBusyReader" - Provides read access to free/busy information. 
- "reader" - Provides read access to the calendar. Private events will appear to users with reader access, but event details will be hidden. 
- "writer" - Provides read and write access to the calendar. Private events will appear to users with writer access, and event details will be visible. 
- "owner" - Provides ownership of the calendar. This role has all of the permissions of the writer role with the additional ability to see and manipulate ACLs.

required.name: rule_id
required.description: ACL rule identifier.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.

optional.name: send_notifications
optional.description: Whether to send notifications about the calendar sharing change. Note that there are no notifications on access removal. Optional. The default is True.

title: Watch ACL Changes
description: Tool to watch for changes to ACL resources. Use when you need to set up real-time notifications for access control list modifications on a calendar.

required.name: id
required.description: A UUID or similar unique string that identifies this channel.

required.name: address
required.description: The address where notifications are delivered for this channel.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.

optional.name: type
optional.description: The type of delivery mechanism used for this channel. Valid values are "web_hook" or "webhook".

optional.name: token
optional.description: An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification delivered over this channel. Optional.

optional.name: params
optional.description: Additional parameters controlling delivery channel behavior. Optional.

title: Add Enrichment
description: Adds an enrichment at a specified position in a defined album.

required.name: album_id
required.description: Identifier of the album where the enrichment is to be added

required.name: album_position
required.description: Position in the album where the enrichment is to be inserted. Required field with valid position types: FIRST_IN_ALBUM, LAST_IN_ALBUM, AFTER_MEDIA_ITEM (requires relativeMediaItemId), AFTER_ENRICHMENT_ITEM (requires relativeEnrichmentItemId)

required.name: new_enrichment_item
required.description: The enrichment to be added, can be a text, location, or map enrichment

title: Modify email labels
description: Adds and/or removes specified Gmail labels for a message; ensure `message_id` and all `label_ids` are valid (use 'listLabels' for custom label IDs).

required.name: message_id
required.description: Immutable ID of the message to modify. Gmail message IDs are hexadecimal strings (e.g., '1a2b3c4d5e6f7890'). IMPORTANT: Do NOT use UUIDs (32-character strings like '093ca4662b214d5eba8f4ceeaad63433'), thread IDs, or internal system IDs - these will cause 'Invalid id value' errors. Obtain valid message IDs from: (1) 'GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS' response 'messageId' field, (2) 'GMAIL_FETCH_MESSAGE_BY_THREAD_ID' response, or (3) 'GMAIL_LIST_THREADS' and then fetching thread messages.

optional.name: user_id
optional.description: User's email address or 'me' for the authenticated user.

optional.name: add_label_ids
optional.description: Label IDs to add (IDs, not display names). System labels: INBOX, SPAM, TRASH, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, CATEGORY_PERSONAL, CATEGORY_SOCIAL, CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS, CATEGORY_UPDATES, CATEGORY_FORUMS. Use full CATEGORY_ prefix (e.g., 'CATEGORY_UPDATES' not 'UPDATES'). Custom labels: call 'listLabels' first to get the ID (format: 'Label_<number>'). Do NOT use the label display name; the API requires the ID. SENT, DRAFT, CHAT are immutable and cannot be added or removed. A label cannot appear in both add_label_ids and remove_label_ids.

optional.name: remove_label_ids
optional.description: Label IDs to remove (IDs, not display names). System labels: INBOX, SPAM, TRASH, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, CATEGORY_PERSONAL, CATEGORY_SOCIAL, CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS, CATEGORY_UPDATES, CATEGORY_FORUMS. Use full CATEGORY_ prefix (e.g., 'CATEGORY_UPDATES' not 'UPDATES'). Custom labels: call 'listLabels' first to get the ID (format: 'Label_<number>'). SENT, DRAFT, CHAT are immutable and cannot be removed. Common operations: to mark as read, remove 'UNREAD'; to archive, remove 'INBOX'. A label cannot appear in both add_label_ids and remove_label_ids.

title: Add or remove to customer list
description: Adds or removes contacts from a Google Ads customer list (UserList/audience/remarketing list), not a Google Ads customer account. Note: It takes 6 to 12 hours for changes to be reflected in the customer list. Email addresses must comply with Google Ads policies and applicable privacy/consent laws.

required.name: emails
required.description: Array of emails of contacts to add to or remove from the customer list. Emails must be valid, normalized strings (lowercase, trimmed); malformed addresses reduce match rates.

required.name: resource_name
required.description: Resource name of the customer list (UserList/audience list), not an account. For example: customers/1234567890/userLists/1234567890. For account-owned resources, use the same customer ID as the tool call's customer_id; in MCC workflows, this is the child/sub-account ID.

optional.name: operation
optional.description: Operation to perform on the customer list (UserList/audience list). Either create or remove.

optional.name: customer_id
optional.description: Target Google Ads customer ID for this tool call; hyphens and spaces are stripped. For MCC workflows, pass the child/sub-account ID. Defaults to the connection customer_id.

title: Insert File Parent (v2)
description: Tool to add a parent folder for a file using Google Drive API v2. Use when you need to add a file to an additional folder.

required.name: id
required.description: The ID of the parent folder to add. This is the folder that will become a parent of the file.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file to add a parent folder to.

optional.name: supports_all_drives
optional.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Default is false.

optional.name: supports_team_drives
optional.description: Deprecated: Use supportsAllDrives instead.

optional.name: enforce_single_parent
optional.description: Deprecated: Adding files to multiple folders is no longer supported. Use shortcuts instead.

title: Insert Property (v2 API)
description: Tool to add a property to a file, or update it if it already exists (v2 API). Use when you need to attach custom key-value metadata to a Google Drive file.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file.

required.name: property_key
required.description: The key of this property.

required.name: property_value
required.description: The value of this property.

optional.name: alt
optional.description: Data format for response.

optional.name: key
optional.description: API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.

optional.name: xgafv
optional.description: V1 error format values.

optional.name: fields
optional.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.

optional.name: callback
optional.description: JSONP callback function name.

optional.name: quota_user
optional.description: Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.

optional.name: upload_type
optional.description: Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. 'media', 'multipart').

optional.name: visibility
optional.description: Property visibility values.

optional.name: oauth_token
optional.description: OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.

optional.name: pretty_print
optional.description: Returns response with indentations and line breaks.

optional.name: access_token
optional.description: OAuth access token.

optional.name: upload_protocol
optional.description: Upload protocol for media (e.g. 'raw', 'multipart').

title: Add Sheet to Existing Spreadsheet
description: Adds a new sheet to a spreadsheet. Supports three sheet types: GRID, OBJECT, and DATA_SOURCE. SHEET TYPES: - GRID (default): Standard spreadsheet with rows/columns. Use properties to set dimensions, tab color, etc. - OBJECT: Sheet containing a chart. Requires objectSheetConfig with chartSpec (basicChart or pieChart). - DATA_SOURCE: Sheet connected to BigQuery. Requires dataSourceConfig with bigQuery spec and bigquery.readonly OAuth scope. OTHER NOTES: - Sheet names must be unique; use forceUnique=true to auto-append suffix (_2, _3) if name exists - For tab colors, use EITHER rgbColor OR themeColor, not both - Avoid 'index' when creating sheets in parallel (causes errors) - OBJECT sheets are created via addChart with position.newSheet=true - DATA_SOURCE sheets require bigquery.readonly OAuth scope Use cases: Add standard grid sheet, create chart on dedicated sheet, connect to BigQuery data source.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: REQUIRED. Cannot be empty. The ID of the target spreadsheet where the new sheet will be added. This is the long alphanumeric string in the Google Sheet URL (e.g., '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms'). Use 'Search Spreadsheets' action to find the spreadsheet ID by name if you don't have it.

optional.name: title
optional.description: The name for the new sheet tab. Must be unique within the spreadsheet. Example: "Q3 Report", "Sales Data 2025". This is a convenience parameter - alternatively, you can set this via properties.title. Note: sheet_name is also accepted as an alias for title.

optional.name: properties
optional.description: Advanced sheet properties (grid dimensions, tab color, position, etc.). For simple cases, just use the 'title' parameter directly. Use this for additional customization.

optional.name: force_unique
optional.description: When True (default), automatically ensures the sheet name is unique by appending a numeric suffix (e.g., '_2', '_3') if the requested name already exists. This makes the action resilient to retries and parallel workflows. When False, the action fails with an error if a sheet with the same name already exists.

optional.name: data_source_config
optional.description:
Configuration for creating a DATA_SOURCE sheet.

DATA_SOURCE sheets connect to external data sources like BigQuery.
The API uses addDataSource request which automatically creates the associated sheet.

IMPORTANT: Requires additional OAuth scope: bigquery.readonly

optional.name: object_sheet_config
optional.description:
Configuration for creating an OBJECT sheet (a sheet containing a chart).

To create an OBJECT sheet, you must provide chart configuration.
The API uses addChart with position.newSheet=true to create the chart on its own sheet.

title: Aggregate Column Data
description: Searches for rows where a specific column matches a value and performs mathematical operations on data from another column.

required.name: operation
required.description: The mathematical operation to perform on the target column values.

required.name: sheet_name
required.description: The name of the specific sheet within the spreadsheet. Matching is case-insensitive. If no exact match is found, partial matches will be attempted (e.g., 'overview' will match 'Overview 2025').

required.name: target_column
required.description: The column to aggregate data from. Can be a letter (e.g., 'C', 'D') or column name from header row (e.g., 'Sales', 'Revenue').

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the Google Sheets spreadsheet.

optional.name: search_value
optional.description: The exact value to search for in the search column. Case-sensitive by default. If not provided (or if search_column is not provided), all rows in the target column will be aggregated without filtering.

optional.name: search_column
optional.description: The column to search in for filtering rows. Can be a letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') or column name from header row (e.g., 'Region', 'Department'). If not provided, all rows in the target column will be aggregated without filtering.

optional.name: case_sensitive
optional.description: Whether the search should be case-sensitive.

optional.name: has_header_row
optional.description: Whether the first row contains column headers. If True, column names can be used for search_column and target_column.

optional.name: percentage_total
optional.description: For percentage operation, the total value to calculate percentage against. If not provided, uses sum of all values in target column.

optional.name: additional_filters
optional.description: Extra column=value conditions applied with AND logic on top of search_column/search_value. Use this to filter on multiple columns simultaneously. Example: [{"column": "Region", "value": "APAC"}] combined with search_column=Product/search_value=Beacon returns only rows where Product=Beacon AND Region=APAC.

title: Append Dimension
description: Tool to append new rows or columns to a sheet, increasing its size. Use when you need to add empty rows or columns to an existing sheet.

required.name: length
required.description: The number of rows or columns to append.

required.name: sheet_id
required.description: The numeric ID of the sheet (not the sheet name). This is a non-negative integer found in the sheet's URL as the 'gid' parameter (e.g., gid=0) or in the sheet properties. The first sheet in a spreadsheet typically has sheet_id=0.

required.name: dimension
required.description: Specifies whether to append rows or columns.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the spreadsheet.

optional.name: response_ranges
optional.description: Limits the ranges of the spreadsheet to include in the response.

optional.name: response_include_grid_data
optional.description: True if grid data should be included in the response (if includeSpreadsheetInResponse is true).

optional.name: include_spreadsheet_in_response
optional.description: True if the updated spreadsheet should be included in the response.

title: Archive Custom Dimension
description: Tool to archive a CustomDimension on a property. Use when you need to remove a custom dimension from active use without permanently deleting it. Archived dimensions cannot be used in new reports.

required.name: name
required.description: Required. The resource name of the CustomDimension to archive. Must be in the exact format: properties/{property_id}/customDimensions/{dimension_id} where property_id and dimension_id are numeric identifiers. IMPORTANT: Must start with 'properties/' prefix, contain '/customDimensions/' in the middle, have no trailing slashes, and no additional path segments. Valid example: 'properties/489591273/customDimensions/13661259421'. Invalid examples: '489591273/13661259421' (missing prefix), 'properties/489591273/customDimensions/13661259421/' (trailing slash), 'properties/489591273/customDimensions/13661259421/extra' (extra segments)

title: Autocomplete Place Predictions
description: Returns place and query predictions for text input. Use when implementing as-you-type autocomplete functionality for place searches. Returns up to five predictions ordered by relevance.

required.name: input
required.description: Text string to search for place predictions. Can be full words, substrings, place names, addresses, or plus codes. Must be non-empty.

optional.name: origin
optional.description: Latitude/longitude point for distance calculations.

optional.name: region_code
optional.description: Region code in ccTLD format for formatting responses (e.g., 'us', 'br').

optional.name: input_offset
optional.description: Zero-based Unicode character offset of cursor position in the input string.

optional.name: language_code
optional.description: Preferred language for results using IETF BCP-47 language codes (e.g., 'en-US', 'es-ES').

optional.name: location_bias
optional.description: Area to bias search results toward.

optional.name: session_token
optional.description: User-generated string grouping calls into sessions for billing purposes.

optional.name: included_region_codes
optional.description: Up to 15 two-character country codes (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2) to restrict results. Query predictions unavailable when this is set.

optional.name: location_restriction
optional.description: Area to restrict search results within.

optional.name: included_primary_types
optional.description: Restricts results to up to five specified primary types (e.g., 'restaurant', 'cafe').

optional.name: include_query_predictions
optional.description: Includes query predictions in response for text searches (default: false).

optional.name: include_pure_service_area_businesses
optional.description: Includes businesses without physical locations (default: false).

title: Auto-Resize Rows or Columns
description: Auto-fit column widths or row heights for a dimension range using batchUpdate.autoResizeDimensions. Use when you need to automatically adjust row heights or column widths to fit content after writing data.

required.name: sheet_id
required.description: The numeric ID of the sheet to resize. Either sheet_id or sheet_name must be provided. If both are provided, sheet_name takes precedence and will be resolved to sheet_id.

required.name: dimension
required.description: The dimension to auto-resize. Use 'ROWS' to auto-fit row heights or 'COLUMNS' to auto-fit column widths.

required.name: end_index
required.description: The zero-based end index of the dimension range to resize (exclusive). Must be greater than start_index. For example, to resize columns A-C, use start_index=0 and end_index=3.

required.name: sheet_name
required.description: The name of the sheet to resize. Either sheet_id or sheet_name must be provided. Using sheet_name is recommended as it's more intuitive. If both sheet_id and sheet_name are provided, sheet_name takes precedence.

required.name: start_index
required.description: The zero-based start index of the dimension range to resize (inclusive). For columns, 0 = column A. For rows, 0 = row 1.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the spreadsheet containing the sheet to resize.

title: Batch Add Media Items
description: Adds one or more media items to an album in Google Photos.

required.name: album_id
required.description: Identifier of the Album that the media items are added to. Must be an album created by this application.

required.name: media_item_ids
required.description: Identifiers of the MediaItems to be added. Maximum 50 items. Media items must be created by this application.

title: Batch Clear Values By Data Filter
description: Clears one or more ranges of values from a spreadsheet using data filters. The caller must specify the spreadsheet ID and one or more DataFilters. Ranges matching any of the specified data filters will be cleared. Only values are cleared -- all other properties of the cell (such as formatting, data validation, etc..) are kept.

required.name: data_filters
required.description: The DataFilters used to determine which ranges to clear.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update.

title: Batch Create Media Items
description: Batch upload and create media items in Google Photos. Supports three input methods: 1. 'urls': Simple list of public URLs (file names extracted automatically) 2. 'media_files': List of objects with url/file, file_name, and description 3. 'files': List of uploaded files Media items can optionally be added to an album at a specific position. Maximum 50 items per request.

optional.name: urls
optional.description: Simplified input: List of public URLs of media files to upload. File names will be extracted from URLs automatically. Use 'media_files' for more control over file names and descriptions.

optional.name: files
optional.description: List of files to upload to Google Photos.

optional.name: album_id
optional.description: Optional identifier of the album where the media items are to be added. If not specified, media items are added to the user's library only.

optional.name: media_files
optional.description: List of media files to upload. Each item can specify either a 'url' (public URL) or a 'file' (FileUploadable object). Maximum 50 items per request.

optional.name: album_position
optional.description: Position in the album to add the media items.

title: Batch delete Gmail messages
description: Tool to permanently delete multiple Gmail messages in bulk, bypassing Trash with no recovery possible. Use when you need to efficiently remove large numbers of emails (e.g., retention enforcement, mailbox hygiene). Use GMAIL_MOVE_TO_TRASH instead when reversibility may be needed. Always obtain explicit user confirmation and verify a sample of message IDs before executing. High-volume calls may trigger 429 rateLimitExceeded or 403 userRateLimitExceeded errors; apply exponential backoff.

required.name: message_ids
required.description: List of Gmail message IDs to delete. Each ID must be a hexadecimal string (e.g., '18c5f5d1a2b3c4d5'). Obtain IDs from actions like GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS or GMAIL_LIST_THREADS - do not use human-readable descriptions.

optional.name: user_id
optional.description: User's email address or 'me' for the authenticated user.

title: Batch Events
description: Execute up to 1000 event mutations (create/patch/delete) in one Google Calendar HTTP batch request with per-item status/results. Use this to materially reduce round-trips for bulk operations like migrations, cleanup, or large-scale updates.

required.name: operations
required.description: List of batch operations to execute. Maximum 1000 operations per request.

optional.name: fail_fast
optional.description: If true, stop processing after the first batch containing any 4xx error (except 404 on DELETE). Default is false.

title: Batch Execute Google Tasks Operations
description: Executes multiple Google Tasks API operations in a single HTTP batch request and returns structured per-item results. Use this to reduce LLM tool invocations when performing bulk operations like updating many tasks, moving tasks, or deleting multiple items. Note: Each sub-request still counts toward API quota; batching primarily reduces HTTP overhead and tool call count.

required.name: requests
required.description: Array of sub-requests to execute in this batch. Each sub-request is independent and will return its own result.

optional.name: max_requests
optional.description: Maximum number of sub-requests allowed in a single batch. Google's typical cap is 1000. Lower values can control response size.

title: Batch get spreadsheet
description: Retrieves data from specified cell ranges in a Google Spreadsheet.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the Google Spreadsheet from which data will be retrieved. This is the ID found in the spreadsheet URL after /d/. You can provide either the spreadsheet ID directly or a full Google Sheets URL (the ID will be extracted automatically).

optional.name: ranges
optional.description: A list of cell ranges in A1 notation from which to retrieve data. If this list is omitted, empty, or contains only empty strings, all data from the first sheet of the spreadsheet will be fetched. Empty strings in the list are automatically filtered out. Supported formats: (1) Bare sheet name like 'Sheet1' to get all data from that sheet, (2) Sheet with range like 'Sheet1!A1:B2', (3) Just cell reference like 'A1:B2' (uses first sheet). For sheet names with spaces or special characters, enclose in single quotes (e.g., "'My Sheet'" or "'My Sheet'!A1:B2"). IMPORTANT: For large sheets, always use bounded ranges with explicit row limits (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:Z10000' instead of 'Sheet1!A:Z'). Unbounded column ranges like 'A:Z' on sheets with >10,000 rows may cause timeouts or errors. If you need all data from a large sheet, fetch in chunks of 10,000 rows at a time.

optional.name: major_dimension
optional.description: The major dimension for organizing data in results.

optional.name: value_render_option
optional.description: How values should be rendered in the output. FORMATTED_VALUE: Values are calculated and formatted (default). UNFORMATTED_VALUE: Values are calculated but not formatted. FORMULA: Values are not calculated; the formula is returned instead.

optional.name: date_time_render_option
optional.description: How dates and times should be rendered in the output. SERIAL_NUMBER: Dates are returned as serial numbers (default). FORMATTED_STRING: Dates returned as formatted strings.

optional.name: empty_strings_filtered
optional.description: Indicates whether empty strings were filtered from the response.

title: Batch Get Media Items
description: Returns the list of media items for the specified media item identifiers.

required.name: media_item_ids
required.description: Identifiers of the media items to be requested. Must not contain duplicates.

title: Batch Get Spreadsheet Values
description: Read multiple explicit ranges from one Google Spreadsheet in one request.

required.name: ranges
required.description: One or more explicit A1 or R1C1 ranges to read, in request order. Every range must be nonblank. Use bounded ranges such as 'Sheet1!A1:D1000' for predictable response sizes.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The Google Spreadsheet ID from its URL.

optional.name: major_dimension
optional.description: Whether returned values are organized by rows or columns.

optional.name: value_render_option
optional.description: How cell values are rendered in the response.

optional.name: date_time_render_option
optional.description: How dates, times, and durations are rendered when values are not formatted.

title: Batch modify Gmail messages
description: Modify labels on multiple Gmail messages in one efficient API call. Supports up to 1,000 messages per request for bulk operations like archiving, marking as read/unread, or applying custom labels. High-volume calls may return 429 rateLimitExceeded or 403 userRateLimitExceeded; apply exponential backoff.

required.name: message_ids
required.description: List of message IDs to modify. Maximum 1,000 message IDs per request. Get message IDs from GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS or GMAIL_LIST_THREADS actions. Accepts 'messageIds', 'ids', or 'message_ids' as the parameter name.

required.name: add_label_ids
required.description: List of label IDs to add to the messages. IMPORTANT: Use label IDs, NOT label display names. System labels use their name as ID: INBOX, STARRED, IMPORTANT, SENT, DRAFT, SPAM, TRASH, UNREAD, CATEGORY_PERSONAL, CATEGORY_SOCIAL, CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS, CATEGORY_UPDATES, CATEGORY_FORUMS. Custom labels MUST use their ID (format: 'Label_XXX', e.g., 'Label_1', 'Label_25'), NOT the display name (e.g., do NOT use 'Work' or 'Projects'). Call GMAIL_LIST_LABELS first to get the 'id' field for custom labels. At least one of add_label_ids or remove_label_ids must be provided. CONSTRAINT: Label IDs must NOT overlap with remove_label_ids - cannot add and remove the same label.

required.name: remove_label_ids
required.description: List of label IDs to remove from the messages. IMPORTANT: Use label IDs, NOT label display names. System labels use their name as ID: INBOX, STARRED, IMPORTANT, SENT, SPAM, TRASH, UNREAD. Custom labels MUST use their ID (format: 'Label_XXX', e.g., 'Label_1', 'Label_25'), NOT the display name (e.g., do NOT use 'Work' or 'Projects'). Call GMAIL_LIST_LABELS first to get the 'id' field for custom labels. Common use cases: Remove 'UNREAD' to mark as read, remove 'INBOX' to archive. Note: 'DRAFT' cannot be removed - use GMAIL_DELETE_DRAFT instead. At least one of add_label_ids or remove_label_ids must be provided. CONSTRAINT: Label IDs must NOT overlap with add_label_ids - cannot add and remove the same label.

optional.name: user_id
optional.description: User's email address or 'me' for the authenticated user.

title: Batch Run Pivot Reports
description: Tool to return multiple pivot reports in a batch for a GA4 property. Use when you need to fetch multiple pivot table reports with multi-dimensional analysis in a single request.

required.name: property
required.description: Required. The GA4 property resource name. Format: properties/{property_id}

required.name: requests
required.description: Required. Up to 5 individual RunPivotReportRequest objects. Each request can have dimensions, metrics, dateRanges, pivots, dimensionFilter, metricFilter, currencyCode, cohortSpec, keepEmptyRows, returnPropertyQuota, and comparisons fields. CRITICAL CONSTRAINT: Every dimension defined in 'dimensions' MUST be used in at least one of: pivots (fieldNames), dimensionFilter, or orderBys. Dimensions not used anywhere will cause a 400 error. The only exception is 'dateRange' dimensions. Additionally, all fieldNames in pivots must reference dimensions defined in the request's 'dimensions' array, and no two pivots can share the same dimension.

title: Batch Run Reports
description: Tool to return multiple analytics data reports in a batch. Use when you need to fetch multiple reports for one GA4 property in a single request.

required.name: property
required.description: Required. The property resource name. Format: properties/{property_id}

required.name: requests
required.description: Required. Up to 5 individual RunReportRequest objects (minimum 1, maximum 5). CRITICAL: Non-cohort requests MUST contain 'dateRanges' (list of {startDate, endDate}); cohort requests (containing 'cohortSpec') must NOT include 'dateRanges'. Key fields per request: dateRanges, dimensions (list of {name}), metrics (list of {name}), dimensionFilter/metricFilter (FilterExpression: use andGroup/orGroup/notExpression/filter at top level), cohortSpec, offset, limit, orderBys, keepEmptyRows. NOTE: Do NOT include 'pivots' field - use batchRunPivotReports action for pivot reports.

optional.name: unwrapped_filters
optional.description: Internal field to track which filters were unwrapped during validation

title: Batch Update Spreadsheet Values
description: Write values to multiple Google Sheets ranges in one batch request.

required.name: data
required.description: The native Google Sheets value ranges to update in request order.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The spreadsheet ID from its Google Sheets URL, not its title.

required.name: value_input_option
required.description: How Google Sheets interprets input values: RAW stores them unchanged; USER_ENTERED parses them as if entered in the Sheets UI.

optional.name: include_values_in_response
optional.description: Whether each update result should include the values written by Google Sheets.

optional.name: response_value_render_option
optional.description: How returned values are rendered when include_values_in_response is true.

optional.name: response_date_time_render_option
optional.description: How returned dates and times are rendered when values are unformatted.

title: Batch Update Values by Data Filter
description: Tool to update values in ranges matching data filters. Use when you need to update specific data in a Google Sheet based on criteria rather than fixed cell ranges.

required.name: data
required.description: The new values to apply to the spreadsheet. If more than one range is matched by the specified DataFilter the specified values are applied to all of those ranges. Can be provided as a JSON string or as a list of DataFilterValueRange objects.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update.

required.name: value_input_option
required.description: How the input data should be interpreted. RAW: Values are stored exactly as entered, without parsing. USER_ENTERED: Values are parsed as if typed by a user (numbers stay numbers, strings prefixed with '=' become formulas, etc.). INPUT_VALUE_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED: Default input value option is not specified.

optional.name: include_values_in_response
optional.description: Determines if the update response should include the values of the cells that were updated. By default, responses do not include the updated values.

optional.name: response_value_render_option
optional.description: Determines how values in the response should be rendered. The default render option is FORMATTED_VALUE.

optional.name: response_date_time_render_option
optional.description: Determines how dates, times, and durations in the response should be rendered. This is ignored if responseValueRenderOption is FORMATTED_VALUE. The default dateTime render option is SERIAL_NUMBER.

title: Remove Calendar from List
description: Tool to remove a calendar from the user's calendar list. Use when you need to unsubscribe from or hide a calendar from the user's list.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the 'primary' keyword.

title: Get Single Calendar by ID
description: Retrieves metadata for a SINGLE specific calendar from the user's calendar list by its calendar ID. This action requires a calendarId parameter and returns details about that one calendar only. NOTE: This does NOT list all calendars. To list all calendars in the user's calendar list, use GOOGLECALENDAR_CALENDAR_LIST_LIST instead.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Required. The calendar identifier for the single calendar to retrieve. Use 'primary' for the primary calendar of the authenticated user, or provide a specific calendar ID (e.g., an email address or group calendar ID). To find calendar IDs, first use GOOGLECALENDAR_CALENDAR_LIST_LIST to list all calendars.

title: Insert Calendar into List
description: Inserts an existing calendar into the user's calendar list, making it visible in the UI. Calendars (e.g., newly created ones) won't appear in the list or UI until explicitly inserted.

required.name: id
required.description: The identifier of the calendar to insert. Must be a valid calendar ID in email format (e.g., ‘user@example.com’ for a user’s calendar or ‘calendarid@group.calendar.google.com’ for a shared calendar). Note: The ‘primary’ keyword is not supported for this operation - use the actual email address of the primary calendar instead. The calendar must exist and you must have appropriate access permissions.

optional.name: hidden
optional.description: Whether the calendar has been hidden from the list. Accepts only boolean values: true or false. If not specified, the API defaults to false.

optional.name: color_id
optional.description: The color of the calendar. This is an ID referring to an entry in the calendarCore color palette.

optional.name: selected
optional.description: Whether the calendar is selected and visible in the calendar list. Accepts only boolean values: true or false. If not specified, the API defaults to false.

optional.name: background_color
optional.description: The background color of the calendar in the Web UI. (Hexadecimal color code)

optional.name: foreground_color
optional.description: The foreground color of the calendar in the Web UI. (Hexadecimal color code)

optional.name: summary_override
optional.description: The summary that the authenticated user has set for this calendar.

optional.name: color_rgb_format
optional.description: Whether to use the foregroundColor and backgroundColor fields to write the calendar colors (RGB). If this feature is used, the index-based colorId field will be set to the best matching option automatically. Optional. The default is False.

optional.name: default_reminders
optional.description: The default reminders that the authenticated user has for this calendar.

optional.name: notification_settings
optional.description: The notifications that the authenticated user is receiving for this calendar.

title: Patch Calendar List Entry
description: Updates an existing calendar on the user's calendar list using patch semantics. This method allows partial updates, modifying only the specified fields.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. Use "primary" keyword for the currently logged in user's primary calendar.

optional.name: hidden
optional.description: Whether calendar is hidden.

optional.name: color_id
optional.description: ID for calendar color from colors endpoint.

optional.name: selected
optional.description: Whether calendar content shows in UI.

optional.name: color_rgb_format
optional.description: Whether to use RGB for foreground/background colors.

optional.name: background_color
optional.description: Hex color for calendar background.

optional.name: foreground_color
optional.description: Hex color for calendar foreground.

optional.name: summary_override
optional.description: User-set summary for the calendar.

optional.name: default_reminders
optional.description: List of default reminders.

optional.name: notification_settings
optional.description: Notification settings for the calendar.

title: Update Calendar List Entry
description: Updates a calendar list entry's display/subscription settings (color, visibility, reminders, selection) for the authenticated user — does not modify the underlying calendar resource (title, timezone, etc.). To modify the calendar itself, use GOOGLECALENDAR_CALENDARS_UPDATE.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. Must be an actual calendar ID (e.g., "examplecalendar@group.calendar.google.com" or "c_abc123...@group.calendar.google.com"). To retrieve valid calendar IDs, use the GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_CALENDARS action first. The "primary" alias is not valid for calendarList.update.

optional.name: hidden
optional.description: Whether calendar is hidden.

optional.name: color_id
optional.description: ID for calendar color from colors endpoint.

optional.name: selected
optional.description: Whether calendar content shows in UI.

optional.name: color_rgb_format
optional.description: Whether to use RGB for foreground/background colors.

optional.name: background_color
optional.description: Hex color for calendar background.

optional.name: foreground_color
optional.description: Hex color for calendar foreground.

optional.name: summary_override
optional.description: User-set summary for the calendar.

optional.name: default_reminders
optional.description: List of default reminders.

optional.name: notification_settings
optional.description: Notification settings for the calendar.

title: Watch Calendar List
description: Watch for changes to CalendarList resources using push notifications. Use this to receive real-time updates when calendar list entries are modified.

required.name: id
required.description: A UUID or similar unique string that identifies this channel. Maximum 64 characters.

required.name: type
required.description: The type of delivery mechanism used for this channel. Must be "web_hook" or "webhook".

required.name: address
required.description: The HTTPS URL where notifications are delivered for this channel. Must have a valid SSL certificate.

optional.name: token
optional.description: An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification. Maximum 256 characters. Used for channel verification and message routing.

optional.name: params
optional.description: Additional parameters controlling delivery channel behavior.

optional.name: expiration
optional.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the API should stop sending notifications.

title: Delete Calendar
description: Deletes a secondary calendar that you own or have delete permissions on. Deletion is permanent and irreversible — verify the correct calendar_id before calling. You cannot delete your primary calendar or calendars you only have read/write access to. Use calendarList.list to find calendars with owner accessRole. For primary calendars, use calendars.clear instead. Parallel calls may trigger userRateLimitExceeded; sequence bulk deletions.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier for a secondary calendar you own or have delete permissions on. Use calendarList.list to find deletable calendar IDs (look for accessRole "owner"). Primary calendars cannot be deleted; use the Clear Calendar action instead.

title: Update Calendar
description: Full PUT-style update that overwrites all calendar metadata fields; unspecified optional fields are cleared. Use GOOGLECALENDAR_PATCH_CALENDAR to update only a subset of fields. Mutates the underlying calendar resource (title, description, timeZone, etc.); use GOOGLECALENDAR_CALENDAR_LIST_UPDATE to change per-user display properties like color.

required.name: summary
required.description: Title of the calendar. Must be a non-empty string; passing an empty string clears the calendar title.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. Use 'primary' to update the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, or provide a specific calendar ID (typically in email format like 'abc123@group.calendar.google.com'). To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. IMPORTANT: This is NOT the calendar's display name/title. NOTE: For better performance, prefer providing the actual calendar ID instead of 'primary', as the 'primary' alias requires an additional API call to resolve.

optional.name: location
optional.description: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text. Optional.

optional.name: time_zone
optional.description: The time zone of the calendar. (Formatted as an IANA Time Zone Database name, e.g. "Europe/Zurich".) Optional.

optional.name: description
optional.description: Description of the calendar. Optional.

title: Stop Channel
description: Tool to stop watching resources through a notification channel. Use when you need to discontinue push notifications for a specific channel subscription.

required.name: id
required.description: A UUID or similar unique string that identifies this channel.

required.name: resource_id
required.description: An opaque ID that identifies the resource being watched on this channel. Stable across different API versions.

optional.name: token
optional.description: An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification delivered over this channel. Optional.

title: Check Compatibility
description: Tool to list dimensions and metrics compatible with a GA4 report request. Use when you need to validate compatibility of chosen dimensions or metrics before running a report.

required.name: property
required.description: Required. GA4 property resource name. Format: properties/{property_id}.

optional.name: metrics
optional.description: Optional. List of metrics to check compatibility for. Maximum of 10 metrics allowed per request.

optional.name: dimensions
optional.description: Optional. List of dimensions to check compatibility for.

optional.name: metric_filter
optional.description: Optional. A FilterExpression for metrics; must follow GA4 FilterExpression JSON schema.

optional.name: dimension_filter
optional.description: Optional. A FilterExpression for dimensions; must follow GA4 FilterExpression JSON schema.

optional.name: compatibility_filter
optional.description:
Compatibility status for dimensions or metrics per Google Analytics Data API v1beta.
Valid values: COMPATIBILITY_UNSPECIFIED, COMPATIBLE, INCOMPATIBLE.
Note: Values like 'REPORT_COMPATIBLE' are NOT valid - use 'COMPATIBLE' instead.

title: Clear Basic Filter
description: Tool to clear the basic filter from a sheet. Use when you need to remove an existing basic filter from a specific sheet within a Google Spreadsheet.

required.name: sheet_id
required.description: The ID of the sheet on which the basic filter should be cleared.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the spreadsheet.

optional.name: response_ranges
optional.description: Limits the ranges included in the response spreadsheet. Only applicable when include_spreadsheet_in_response is true.

optional.name: response_include_grid_data
optional.description: True if grid data should be returned in the response. Only applicable when include_spreadsheet_in_response is true.

optional.name: include_spreadsheet_in_response
optional.description: Determines if the update response should include the spreadsheet resource.

title: Clear Calendar
description: Clears a primary calendar by deleting all events from it. The calendar itself is preserved; only its events are removed. Primary calendars cannot be deleted entirely.

required.name: calendar_id
required.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the `calendarList.list` method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "`primary`" keyword.

title: Clear Spreadsheet Values
description: Permanently clear values from one range while preserving formatting, notes, and validation.

required.name: range
required.description: The A1 or R1C1 notation of the single range whose values should be permanently cleared, such as 'Sheet1!A1:B10'.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the Google Sheets spreadsheet containing the values to clear.

title: Clear tasks
description: Permanently and irreversibly clears all completed tasks from a specified Google Tasks list; this action is destructive, idempotent, and cannot be undone. Always require explicit user confirmation before invoking.

required.name: tasklist
required.description: The identifier of the task list from which to clear completed tasks. Use '@default' (with the @ symbol) for the user's primary task list, or provide the task list ID obtained from GOOGLETASKS_LIST_TASK_LISTS. Note: 'default' without the @ prefix is not valid.

title: Clear spreadsheet values
description: Clears cell content (preserving formatting and notes) from a specified A1 notation range in a Google Spreadsheet; the range must correspond to an existing sheet and cells.

required.name: range
required.description: The A1 notation of the range to clear values from (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:B2', 'MySheet!C:C', or 'A1:D5'). If the sheet name is omitted (e.g., 'A1:B2'), the operation applies to the first visible sheet.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the Google Spreadsheet from which to clear values. This ID can be found in the URL of the spreadsheet.

title: Get Color Definitions
description: Returns the color definitions for calendars and events. Use when you need to retrieve the available color palette for styling calendars or events.

title: Compute Route Matrix
description: Calculates travel distance and duration matrix between multiple origins and destinations using the modern Routes API; supports OAuth2 authentication and various travel modes. Matrix is capped at 625 elements (e.g., 25×25); chunk larger sets to avoid RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors. Response elements may be returned out of input order — always use originIndex and destinationIndex to map results. Only use elements where condition='ROUTE_EXISTS'; the matrix may be incomplete.

required.name: origins
required.description: List of origin locations. Each can be specified as an address or latitude/longitude coordinates.

required.name: destinations
required.description: List of destination locations. Each can be specified as an address or latitude/longitude coordinates.

optional.name: units
optional.description: Unit system (e.g., 'METRIC' for kilometers, 'IMPERIAL' for miles) for displaying distances. Note: distanceMeters in responses is always in meters regardless of this setting; units affects only human-readable text output.

optional.name: field_mask
optional.description: Comma-separated list of response fields to include (e.g., 'originIndex,destinationIndex,duration,distanceMeters'). Use '*' for all fields.

optional.name: travel_mode
optional.description: Mode of transportation for the route matrix calculation.

optional.name: language_code
optional.description: BCP-47 language code (e.g., 'en-US', 'es') for textual information.

optional.name: routing_preference
optional.description: Specifies factors to consider when calculating the route.

title: Copy Google Document
description: Tool to create a copy of an existing Google Document. Use this to duplicate a document, for example, when using an existing document as a template. The copied document will have a default title (e.g., 'Copy of [original title]') if no new title is provided, and will be placed in the user's root Google Drive folder.

required.name: document_id
required.description: The ID of the Google Document to be copied.

optional.name: title
optional.description: The title for the new copied document. If not provided, the title will be 'Copy of [original document's title]'.

optional.name: include_shared_drives
optional.description: Whether to support copying documents from shared drives. Defaults to True.

title: Copy file with advanced options
description: Creates a copy of a file and applies any requested updates with patch semantics. Use when you need to duplicate a file with advanced options like label inclusion, visibility settings, or custom metadata.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file to copy. This is the unique identifier for the file on Google Drive.

optional.name: alt
optional.description: Data format for response.

optional.name: key
optional.description: API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.

optional.name: name
optional.description: The name of the copied file. If not provided, the copied file will have the same name as the original, prefixed with 'Copy of '.

optional.name: xgafv
optional.description: V1 error format options.

optional.name: fields
optional.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. Use comma-separated field paths.

optional.name: parents
optional.description: The IDs of the parent folders which contain the file. If not specified as part of a copy request, the file inherits any discoverable parents of the source file.

optional.name: starred
optional.description: Whether the user has starred the file.

optional.name: trashed
optional.description: Whether the file has been trashed.

optional.name: callback
optional.description: JSONP callback parameter.

optional.name: mime_type
optional.description: The MIME type of the file. Google Drive attempts to automatically detect an appropriate value from uploaded content, if no value is provided.

optional.name: quota_user
optional.description: Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.

optional.name: properties
optional.description: A collection of arbitrary key-value pairs which are visible to all apps. Entries with null values are cleared in update and copy requests.

optional.name: upload_type
optional.description: Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. 'media', 'multipart').

optional.name: created_time
optional.description: The time at which the file was created (RFC 3339 date-time).

optional.name: description
optional.description: A short description of the copied file.

optional.name: oauth_token
optional.description: OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.

optional.name: ocr_language
optional.description: A language hint for OCR processing during image import (ISO 639-1 code).

optional.name: pretty_print
optional.description: Returns response with indentations and line breaks for improved readability.

optional.name: access_token
optional.description: OAuth access token.

optional.name: modified_time
optional.description: The last time the file was modified by anyone (RFC 3339 date-time). Note that setting modifiedTime will also update modifiedByMeTime for the user.

optional.name: app_properties
optional.description: A collection of arbitrary key-value pairs which are private to the requesting app. Entries with null values are cleared in update and copy requests. These properties can only be retrieved using an authenticated request with an OAuth 2 client ID.

optional.name: include_labels
optional.description: A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the labelInfo part of the response.

optional.name: folder_color_rgb
optional.description: The color for a folder or a shortcut to a folder as an RGB hex string. The supported colors are published in the folderColorPalette field of the About resource.

optional.name: upload_protocol
optional.description: Upload protocol for media (e.g. 'raw', 'multipart').

optional.name: writers_can_share
optional.description: Whether users with only writer permission can modify the file's permissions. Not populated for items in shared drives.

optional.name: supports_all_drives
optional.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives.

optional.name: supports_team_drives
optional.description: Deprecated: Use supportsAllDrives instead.

optional.name: enforce_single_parent
optional.description: Deprecated. Copying files into multiple folders is no longer supported. Use shortcuts instead.

optional.name: keep_revision_forever
optional.description: Whether to set the 'keepForever' field in the new head revision. This is only applicable to files with binary content in Google Drive. Only 200 revisions for the file can be kept forever. If the limit is reached, try deleting pinned revisions.

optional.name: ignore_default_visibility
optional.description: Whether to ignore the domain's default visibility settings for the created file. Domain administrators can choose to make all uploaded files visible to the domain by default; this parameter bypasses that behavior for the request. Permissions are still inherited from parent folders.

optional.name: include_permissions_for_view
optional.description: Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response. Only 'published' is supported.

optional.name: copy_requires_writer_permission
optional.description: Whether the options to copy, print, or download this file should be disabled for readers and commenters.

title: Create Album
description: Creates a new album in Google Photos.

required.name: title
required.description: Name of the album to be created in Google Photos. Maximum 500 characters.

title: Create and Populate Table in Google Doc
description: Creates a new table in a Google Document and populates its cells with provided text data in a single operation. Use this action when you need to insert a structured table with predefined content into a document. The action handles both table creation and cell population automatically, eliminating the need for separate operations.

required.name: rows
required.description: The number of rows in the table. Must be between 1 and 20.

required.name: columns
required.description: The number of columns in the table. Must be between 1 and 20.

required.name: cell_data
required.description: A 2D array (list of lists) containing the text content for each cell. The outer list represents rows, and each inner list represents columns. Must match the dimensions specified by 'rows' and 'columns'. Empty strings are allowed for empty cells.

required.name: document_id
required.description: The ID of the document to update.

optional.name: index
optional.description: The zero-based index where the table will be inserted, in UTF-16 code units. The index must be strictly less than the segment's end index. To insert at the end of a segment, omit this parameter and set 'insertAtEndOfSegment' to true instead.

optional.name: tab_id
optional.description: The tab that the location is in. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab.

optional.name: segment_id
optional.description: The ID of the header, footer or footnote the location is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.

optional.name: insert_at_end_of_segment
optional.description: If true, inserts the table at the end of the segment (document body, header, or footer specified by segment_id). If false or omitted, and 'index' is not provided, it defaults to inserting at the end of the document body.

title: Create Audience Export
description: Tool to create an audience export for Google Analytics. Use when you need to export a snapshot of users in an audience at a specific point in time. This initiates a long-running asynchronous request that returns an operation resource name immediately. The export begins in CREATING state with rowCount=0; the operation must complete before export data is accessible for querying.

required.name: parent
required.description: Parent property resource name where the audience export will be created. Format: properties/{property_id}.

required.name: audience
required.description: Audience resource name identifying the audience to export. Format: properties/{property_id}/audiences/{audience_id}.

optional.name: dimensions
optional.description: Optional list of dimensions requested and displayed in the export. Each dimension is specified by dimensionName.

title: Create Audience List
description: Tool to create an audience list for later retrieval by initiating a long-running asynchronous request. Use when you need to create a snapshot of users currently in an audience. The method returns quickly with an Operation resource while processing occurs in the background.

required.name: parent
required.description: Required. The parent property resource name. Format: 'properties/{property_id}'. Example: 'properties/489591273'

required.name: audience
required.description: Required. The audience resource name identifying the audience being listed. Format: 'properties/{property_id}/audiences/{audience_id}'. Example: 'properties/489591273/audiences/11228260226'

required.name: dimensions
required.description: Required. The dimensions requested and displayed in the query response. At least one dimension is required. Each entry must be an object with a `dimensionName` key (e.g., `[{'dimensionName': 'deviceId'}]`). Only dimensions supported for audience lists on that property are valid; unsupported values return a 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT error. Use GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_GET_METADATA to retrieve valid dimension names.

optional.name: webhook_notification
optional.description: Webhook notification configuration for audience list operation updates.

title: Create a new calendar
description: Creates a new secondary Google Calendar with the specified title and optional settings. Use this action when you need to create a new calendar for organizing events separately from the primary calendar. The authenticated user becomes the owner of the newly created calendar. Optional parameters include description, location, and timezone.

required.name: summary
required.description: Title of the calendar. This is the name that will be displayed in Google Calendar.

optional.name: location
optional.description: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text.

optional.name: timezone
optional.description: The time zone of the calendar, specified as an IANA Time Zone Database name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo'). If not specified, defaults to UTC.

optional.name: description
optional.description: Description of the calendar. Provides additional context about the calendar's purpose.

title: Create Callout Asset
description: Create an immutable account asset containing a validated callout. Associate the returned resource using Mutate Customer Assets with field_type CALLOUT. Cleanup removes that association; Google does not allow deleting the asset.

required.name: callout
required.description: Validated callout content and optional schedule.

optional.name: name
optional.description: Optional internal name for the immutable callout asset.

optional.name: customer_id
optional.description: Target Google Ads customer ID for this tool call; hyphens and spaces are stripped. For MCC workflows, pass the child/sub-account ID. Defaults to the connection customer_id.

optional.name: validate_only
optional.description: If true, validates the request without applying changes.

optional.name: partial_failure
optional.description: If true, valid operations succeed even when other operations fail. Invalid operations are returned in partial_failure_error.

optional.name: response_content_type
optional.description: Controls how much of each mutated Google Ads resource is returned.

title: Create Chart in Google Sheets
description: Create a chart in a Google Sheets spreadsheet using the specified data range and chart type. Conditional requirements: - Provide either a simple chart via chart_type + data_range (basicChart), OR supply a full chart_spec supporting all chart types. Exactly one approach should be used. - When using chart_spec, set exactly one of the union fields (basicChart | pieChart | bubbleChart | candlestickChart | histogramChart | waterfallChart | treemapChart | orgChart | scorecardChart).

required.name: sheet_id
required.description: The numeric sheetId (not the sheet name/title) of the worksheet where the chart will be created. This is a unique integer identifier for the sheet within the spreadsheet. The first/default sheet typically has sheetId=0. IMPORTANT: Use 'Get Spreadsheet Info' action to retrieve valid sheetIds - look for sheets[].properties.sheetId in the response. The sheetId must exist in the target spreadsheet; using an ID from a different spreadsheet will fail.

required.name: chart_type
required.description: Type of chart to create. Supported types: BAR, LINE, AREA, COLUMN, SCATTER, COMBO, STEPPED_AREA, PIE, HISTOGRAM, BUBBLE, CANDLESTICK, TREEMAP, WATERFALL, ORG, SCORECARD. Case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant.

required.name: data_range
required.description: A single contiguous range of data for the chart in A1 notation (e.g., 'A1:C10' or 'Sheet1!B2:D20'). Must be a single continuous range - comma-separated multi-ranges (e.g., 'A1:A10,C1:C10') are not supported. When chart_spec is not provided, the first column is used as the domain/labels and the remaining columns as series. IMPORTANT: PIE charts require at least 2 columns - the first column for category labels (domain) and the second column for numeric values (series). Single-column ranges are not supported for PIE charts.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the Google Sheets spreadsheet where the chart will be created. Must be the actual spreadsheet ID from the URL (e.g., '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms'), NOT the spreadsheet name or title. Find it in the URL: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/SPREADSHEET_ID/edit

optional.name: title
optional.description: Optional title for the chart.

optional.name: subtitle
optional.description: Optional subtitle for the chart.

optional.name: chart_spec
optional.description: Optional full ChartSpec object to send to the Google Sheets API. Use this to support ALL chart types and advanced options. Must set exactly one of: basicChart, pieChart, bubbleChart, candlestickChart, histogramChart, treemapChart, waterfallChart, orgChart, scorecardChart. See https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/charts#ChartSpec.

optional.name: x_axis_title
optional.description: Optional title for the X-axis.

optional.name: y_axis_title
optional.description: Optional title for the Y-axis.

optional.name: background_red
optional.description: Red component of chart background color (0.0-1.0). If not specified, uses default.

optional.name: background_blue
optional.description: Blue component of chart background color (0.0-1.0). If not specified, uses default.

optional.name: legend_position
optional.description: Position of the chart legend. Options: BOTTOM_LEGEND, TOP_LEGEND, LEFT_LEGEND, RIGHT_LEGEND, NO_LEGEND.

optional.name: background_green
optional.description: Green component of chart background color (0.0-1.0). If not specified, uses default.

title: Create Comment
description: Tool to create a comment on a file in Google Drive. Returns a nested `data` object; extract `data.id` for the resulting comment identifier. Omit `anchor` and `quoted_file_content_*` for general file-level comments.

required.name: content
required.description: The plain text content of the comment.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file. The `id` field from GOOGLEDOCS_SEARCH_DOCUMENTS results can be used directly without conversion.

optional.name: anchor
optional.description: A JSON string defining the region of the document to which the comment is anchored. Format: {"region": {"kind": "drive#commentRegion", "<classifier>": <value>, "rev": "head"}}. Supported classifiers: (1) "line" for text lines (e.g., "line": 12), (2) "page" for page numbers (e.g., "page": {"p": 0}), (3) "txt" for text ranges (e.g., "txt": {"o": 100, "l": 50}), (4) "rect" for rectangles in images (e.g., "rect": {"x": 10, "y": 20, "w": 100, "h": 50}), (5) "time" for video timestamps (e.g., "time": {"t": "00:01:30"}), (6) "matrix" for spreadsheet cells (e.g., "matrix": {"c": 2, "r": 5}). Note: On blob files, only unanchored comments are supported. Google Workspace editors may treat API-set anchors as unanchored.

optional.name: quoted_file_content_value
optional.description: The quoted content itself.

optional.name: quoted_file_content_mime_type
optional.description: The MIME type of the quoted content.

title: Create Custom Dimension
description: Tool to create a CustomDimension for a Google Analytics property. Use when you need to add a new custom dimension to track specific user properties, event parameters, or eCommerce item parameters.

required.name: scope
required.description: Required. Immutable. The scope of this dimension. Must be one of: EVENT, USER, or ITEM

required.name: parent
required.description: Required. The property in which to create the CustomDimension. Format: properties/{property_id}

required.name: display_name
required.description: Required. Display name for this custom dimension as shown in the Analytics UI. Max length of 82 characters, alphanumeric plus space and underscore starting with a letter

required.name: parameter_name
required.description: Required. Immutable. Tagging parameter name for this custom dimension. For user-scoped dimensions, this is the user property name. For event-scoped dimensions, this is the event parameter name. For item-scoped dimensions, this is the parameter name in the eCommerce items array. May only contain alphanumeric and underscore characters, starting with a letter. Max length of 24 characters for user-scoped dimensions, 40 characters for event-scoped dimensions

optional.name: description
optional.description: Optional. Description for this custom dimension. Max length of 150 characters

optional.name: disallow_ads_personalization
optional.description: Optional. If set to true, sets this dimension as NPA and excludes it from ads personalization. This is currently only supported by user-scoped custom dimensions

title: Create customer list
description: Creates a Google Ads customer list (UserList/audience/remarketing list), not a Google Ads customer account. Note: Requires an authenticated Google Ads connection with customer_id configured. Email-based lists must comply with Google Ads policies and applicable privacy/consent laws. Membership updates can take many hours to propagate; targeting eligibility is not immediate after creation.

required.name: name
required.description: Name of the Google Ads customer list (UserList/audience list), not an account.

optional.name: customer_id
optional.description: Target Google Ads customer ID for this tool call; hyphens and spaces are stripped. For MCC workflows, pass the child/sub-account ID. Defaults to the connection customer_id.

optional.name: description
optional.description: Description of the Google Ads customer list (UserList/audience list), not an account.

title: Create Custom Metric
description: Tool to create a custom metric in Google Analytics. Use when you need to define a new custom metric for tracking specific event parameters.

required.name: scope
required.description: Required. Immutable. The scope of this custom metric.

required.name: parent
required.description: Required. The property where the custom metric will be created. Format: properties/{property_id}

required.name: display_name
required.description: Required. Display name for this custom metric as shown in the Analytics UI. Max length of 82 characters, alphanumeric plus space and underscore starting with a letter.

required.name: parameter_name
required.description: Required. Immutable. Tagging name for this custom metric. If this is an event-scoped metric, then this is the event parameter name. May only contain alphanumeric and underscore characters, starting with a letter. Max length of 40 characters for event-scoped metrics.

required.name: measurement_unit
required.description: Required. The type for the custom metric's value.

optional.name: description
optional.description: Optional. Description for this custom metric. Max length of 150 characters.

optional.name: restricted_metric_type
optional.description: Optional. Types of restricted data that this metric may contain. Required for metrics with CURRENCY measurement unit. Must be empty for metrics with a non-CURRENCY measurement unit.

title: Create a document
description: Creates a new Google Docs document using the provided title as filename and inserts the initial text at the beginning if non-empty, returning the document's ID and metadata (excluding body content).

required.name: title
required.description: Title for the new document, used as its filename in Google Drive.

optional.name: text
optional.description: Optional initial text content to insert at the beginning of the new document. If not provided, an empty document will be created. For very large text (over 50,000 characters), the text will be inserted in chunks to avoid API limits.

title: Create Document Markdown
description: Creates a new Google Docs document, optionally initializing it with a title and content provided as Markdown text.

required.name: title
required.description: The title for the new Google Docs document.

optional.name: image_assets
optional.description: Optional uploaded images that Markdown can reference by name. Use Markdown image syntax like ![Alt](attachment://diagram). Public HTTPS image URLs in markdown do not need image_assets.

optional.name: markdown_text
optional.description: The initial content for the document, formatted as Markdown. Also accepts 'content' as an alias. Supports headings, real Google Docs lists including nested lists, multiple Markdown tables, task-list markers, images via publicly accessible URLs or matching image_assets uploads (max 2KB URL length after resolution; formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF; SVG not supported), blockquotes, code blocks, hyperlinks (e.g., [text](url)), and text formatting (bold, italic, etc.). If empty or omitted, creates document with title only.

title: Create Shared Drive
description: Tool to create a new shared drive. Use when you need to programmatically create a new shared drive for collaboration or storage.

required.name: name
required.description: The name of this shared drive.

optional.name: hidden
optional.description: Whether the shared drive is hidden from default view.

optional.name: theme_id
optional.description: The ID of the theme from which the background image and color will be set. The set of possible driveThemes can be retrieved from a drive.about.get response. When not specified on a drive.drives.create request, a random theme is chosen from which the background image and color are set. This is a write-only field; it can only be set on requests that don't set colorRgb or backgroundImageFile.

optional.name: color_rgb
optional.description: The color of this shared drive as an RGB hex string. It can only be set on a drive.drives.update request that does not set themeId.

optional.name: request_id
optional.description: Optional. An ID for idempotent creation of a shared drive. If not provided, a UUID will be auto-generated. Each requestId can only be used ONCE to successfully create a drive. If retrying a request that succeeded previously with the same requestId, the existing drive will be returned.

optional.name: background_image_file
optional.description: An image file and cropping parameters from which a background image for this shared drive is set. This is a write only field; it can only be set on drive.drives.update requests that don't set themeId. When specified, all fields of the backgroundImageFile must be set.

title: Create email draft
description: Creates a Gmail email draft. While all fields are optional per the Gmail API, practical validation requires at least one of recipient_email, cc, or bcc and at least one of subject or body. Supports To/Cc/Bcc recipients, subject, plain/HTML body (ensure `is_html=True` for HTML), attachments, and threading. Returns a draft_id that must be used as-is with GMAIL_SEND_DRAFT — synthetic or stale IDs will fail.
