deleteTableRow: Requires tableCellLocation object (NOT top-level rowIndex/tableStartLocation). Structure: { tableCellLocation: { tableStartLocation: { index: N }, rowIndex: R, columnIndex: C } }.

updateTableCellStyle: Use EITHER tableStartLocation (all cells) OR tableRange (specific cells), not both.

Style updates (updateParagraphStyle, updateTextStyle, updateTableCellStyle, updateDocumentStyle): The 'fields' parameter is auto-populated from style keys if omitted.

Document title CANNOT be updated via batchUpdate - use Google Drive API instead.

updateDocumentStyle valid fields: background, marginTop, marginBottom, marginLeft, marginRight, marginHeader, marginFooter, pageSize, pageNumberStart, useEvenPageHeaderFooter, useFirstPageHeaderFooter, flipPageOrientation (NOT "title").

required.name: document_id
required.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the Google Docs document to be updated.

title: Update File Metadata (PATCH v2)
description: Tool to update file metadata using the Drive API v2 PATCH method. Use when you need to modify file properties like title, description, or labels using patch semantics.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file to update.

optional.name: ocr
optional.description: Whether to attempt OCR on .jpg, .png, .gif, or .pdf uploads.

optional.name: title
optional.description: The title of the file. Used to change the name of the file.

optional.name: labels
optional.description: A group of labels for the file. For example: {'starred': true, 'trashed': false, 'restricted': false, 'viewed': true}.

optional.name: pinned
optional.description: Whether to pin the new revision. A file can have a maximum of 200 pinned revisions.

optional.name: mime_type
optional.description: The MIME type of the file.

optional.name: add_parents
optional.description: Comma-separated list of parent IDs to add.

optional.name: properties
optional.description: The list of properties.

optional.name: description
optional.description: A short description of the file.

optional.name: new_revision
optional.description: Whether a blob upload should create a new revision. If not set, a new revision is created.

optional.name: ocr_language
optional.description: If ocr is true, hints at the language to use. Valid values are BCP 47 codes.

optional.name: modified_date
optional.description: Last time this file was modified by anyone (RFC 3339 date-time). Requires setModifiedDate=true.

optional.name: include_labels
optional.description: A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the labelInfo part of the response.

optional.name: indexable_text
optional.description: Indexable text attributes for the file (can be used to improve fulltext queries).

optional.name: remove_parents
optional.description: Comma-separated list of parent IDs to remove.

optional.name: set_modified_date
optional.description: Whether to set the modified date using the value supplied in the request body.

optional.name: writers_can_share
optional.description: Whether writers can share the document with other users.

optional.name: update_viewed_date
optional.description: Whether to update the view date after successfully updating the file.

optional.name: supports_all_drives
optional.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true.

optional.name: timed_text_language
optional.description: The language of the timed text.

optional.name: timed_text_track_name
optional.description: The timed text track name.

optional.name: include_permissions_for_view
optional.description: Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response. Only 'published' is supported.

optional.name: use_content_as_indexable_text
optional.description: Whether to use the content as indexable text.

title: Update Property (v2 API)
description: Tool to update a property on a file using Google Drive API v2. Use when you need to modify an existing custom property attached to a file.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file.

required.name: property_key
required.description: The key of the property.

optional.name: alt
optional.description: Data format for response.

optional.name: key
optional.description: API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.

optional.name: xgafv
optional.description: V1 error format values.

optional.name: fields
optional.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.

optional.name: callback
optional.description: JSONP callback function name.

optional.name: quota_user
optional.description: Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.

optional.name: upload_type
optional.description: Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. 'media', 'multipart').

optional.name: visibility
optional.description: Visibility options for the property.

optional.name: oauth_token
optional.description: OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.

optional.name: pretty_print
optional.description: Returns response with indentations and line breaks.

optional.name: access_token
optional.description: OAuth access token.

optional.name: property_value
optional.description: The value of this property.

optional.name: upload_protocol
optional.description: Upload protocol for media (e.g. 'raw', 'multipart').

optional.name: property_visibility
optional.description: Visibility options for the property.

title: Update File (Metadata)
description: Updates file metadata. Uses PATCH semantics (partial update) as per Google Drive API v3 — only explicitly provided fields are updated, so omit fields you do not intend to overwrite. Use this tool to modify attributes of an existing file like its name, description, or parent folders. To move a file, supply add_parents and remove_parents together; omitting remove_parents creates multiple parents, omitting add_parents can orphan the file. Bulk updates may trigger 429 Too Many Requests; apply exponential backoff. Note: supports metadata updates only; file content updates are not yet implemented.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file to update.

optional.name: name
optional.description: The name of the file. Google Drive does not enforce name uniqueness within a folder; duplicate names are allowed and can cause ambiguous results when searching by name.

optional.name: starred
optional.description: Whether the user has starred the file.

optional.name: mime_type
optional.description: The MIME type of the file. Google Drive will attempt to automatically detect an appropriate value from uploaded content if no value is provided. The value cannot be changed unless a new revision is uploaded.

optional.name: add_parents
optional.description: Comma-separated list of folder IDs (not folder names) to add as parents. Folder IDs are alphanumeric strings typically 20+ characters long (e.g., '1A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9I0J'). Folder names will not work and will cause a 'Parent folder not found' error. Moving a file requires pairing with remove_parents (source folder ID); omitting remove_parents results in multiple parents. Reparenting to a shared folder changes collaborator access to that folder's permissions.

optional.name: description
optional.description: A short description of the file.

optional.name: ocr_language
optional.description: A language hint for OCR processing during image import (ISO 639-1 code).

optional.name: remove_parents
optional.description: Comma-separated list of folder IDs (not folder names) to remove as parents. Folder IDs are alphanumeric strings typically 20+ characters long (e.g., '1A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9I0J'). Folder names will not work and will cause a 'Parent folder not found' error.

optional.name: writers_can_share
optional.description: Whether writers can share the document with other users.

optional.name: supports_all_drives
optional.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true to ensure compatibility with shared drive files.

optional.name: keep_revision_forever
optional.description: Whether to set this revision of the file to be kept forever. This is only applicable to files with binary content in Google Drive. Only 200 revisions for the file can be kept forever. If the limit is reached, try deleting pinned revisions.

optional.name: use_domain_admin_access
optional.description: Whether the requesting application is using domain-wide delegation to access content belonging to a user in a different domain. This is only applicable to files with binary content in Google Drive.

optional.name: viewers_can_copy_content
optional.description: Whether viewers are prevented from copying content of the file.

title: Update File Revision Metadata
description: Updates ONLY the metadata properties of a specific file revision (keepForever, published, publishAuto, publishedOutsideDomain). IMPORTANT: This action does NOT update file content. To update file content, use EDIT_FILE or UPDATE_FILE_PUT instead. This action requires BOTH file_id AND revision_id parameters. Use LIST_REVISIONS to get available revision IDs for a file. Valid parameters: file_id (required), revision_id (required), keep_forever, published, publish_auto, published_outside_domain. Invalid parameters (use other actions): file_contents, mime_type, content, name - these are NOT supported by this action.

required.name: file_id
required.description: Required. The ID of the file whose revision metadata you want to update. Use LIST_FILES or FIND_FILE to get the file ID.

required.name: revision_id
required.description: Required. The ID of the revision to update. Use LIST_REVISIONS to get available revision IDs for a file.

optional.name: published
optional.description: Whether this revision is published. This is only applicable to Docs Editors files.

optional.name: keep_forever
optional.description: Whether to keep this revision forever, even if it is no longer the head revision. If not set, the revision will be automatically purged 30 days after newer content is uploaded. This can be set on a maximum of 200 revisions for a file. This field is only applicable to files with binary content in Drive.

optional.name: publish_auto
optional.description: Whether subsequent revisions will be automatically republished. This is only applicable to Docs Editors files.

optional.name: published_outside_domain
optional.description: Whether this revision is published outside the domain. This is only applicable to Docs Editors files.

title: Update IMAP settings
description: Tool to update IMAP settings for a Gmail account. Use when you need to modify IMAP configuration such as enabling/disabling IMAP, setting auto-expunge behavior, or configuring folder size limits.

optional.name: enabled
optional.description: Whether IMAP is enabled for the account.

optional.name: user_id
optional.description: The user's email address. The special value 'me' can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

optional.name: auto_expunge
optional.description: If this value is true, Gmail will immediately expunge a message when it is marked as deleted in IMAP. Otherwise, Gmail will wait for an update from the client before expunging messages marked as deleted.

optional.name: max_folder_size
optional.description: An optional limit on the number of messages that an IMAP folder may contain. Legal values are 0, 1000, 2000, 5000 or 10000. A value of zero is interpreted to mean that there is no limit.

optional.name: expunge_behavior
optional.description: The action that will be executed on a message when it is marked as deleted and expunged from the last visible IMAP folder. Possible values: 'expungeBehaviorUnspecified' (Unspecified behavior), 'archive' (Archive messages marked as deleted), 'trash' (Move messages marked as deleted to the trash), 'deleteForever' (Immediately and permanently delete messages marked as deleted).

title: Update Label
description: Tool to update the properties of an existing Gmail label. Use when you need to modify label name, visibility settings, or color.

required.name: id
required.description: The ID of the label to update.

required.name: color
required.description: Color settings for the label. Both backgroundColor and textColor must be provided together.

optional.name: name
optional.description: The display name of the label.

optional.name: user_id
optional.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

optional.name: label_list_visibility
optional.description: Visibility of the label in the label list (Gmail sidebar).

optional.name: message_list_visibility
optional.description: Visibility of messages with this label in the message list.

title: Update Language Settings
description: Tool to update the language settings for a Gmail user. Use when you need to change the display language preference for the authenticated user or a specific Gmail account. The returned displayLanguage may differ from the requested value if Gmail selects a close variant.

required.name: display_language
required.description: The language to display Gmail in, formatted as an RFC 3066 Language Tag (e.g., 'en-GB' for British English, 'fr' for French, 'ja' for Japanese, 'es' for Spanish, 'de' for German, 'en' for English). The set of languages supported by Gmail evolves over time. Note: Gmail may save a close variant if the requested language is not directly supported. For example, if you request a regional variant that's not available, Gmail may save the base language instead.

optional.name: user_id
optional.description: The email address of the Gmail user whose language settings are to be updated, or the special value 'me' to indicate the currently authenticated user.

title: Update Media Item
description: Updates a media item's description in Google Photos.

required.name: description
required.description: New description for the media item. Must be shorter than 1000 characters.

required.name: media_item_id
required.description: Identifier of the media item to update

title: Update Permission
description: Tool to update a permission with patch semantics. Use when you need to modify an existing permission for a file or shared drive. Inherited or domain-managed permissions may not be editable; verify editability with GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_PERMISSIONS before updating.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file or shared drive.

required.name: permission
required.description: The permission resource to update. Only 'role' and 'expirationTime' can be updated. Role changes take effect immediately and can be difficult to reverse; confirm intent before applying.

required.name: permission_id
required.description: The ID of the permission. For anyone-type permissions, use 'anyone' as the permission ID.

optional.name: remove_expiration
optional.description: Whether to remove the expiration date.

optional.name: supports_all_drives
optional.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Must be set to true when operating on shared drives; omitting this causes the request to fail.

optional.name: transfer_ownership
optional.description: Whether to transfer ownership to the specified user and downgrade the current owner to a writer. This parameter is required as an acknowledgement of the side effect when set to true.

optional.name: use_domain_admin_access
optional.description: Issue the request as a domain administrator; if set to true, then the requester will be granted access if the file ID parameter refers to a shared drive and the requester is an administrator of the domain to which the shared drive belongs.

optional.name: enforce_expansive_access
optional.description: Whether the request should enforce expansive access rules. This field is deprecated, it is recommended to use `permissionDetails` instead.

title: Update POP settings
description: Tool to update POP settings for a Gmail account. Use when you need to configure POP access window or message disposition behavior.

optional.name: user_id
optional.description: The user's email address. The special value 'me' can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

optional.name: disposition
optional.description: The action that will be executed on a message after it has been fetched via POP.

optional.name: access_window
optional.description: The range of messages which are accessible via POP.

title: Update Property
description: Tool to update an existing GA4 Property. Use when you need to modify property settings such as display name, time zone, currency code, or industry category.

required.name: name
required.description: Required. The resource name of the Property to update. Must be in the exact format: properties/{property_id} where property_id is a numeric identifier. IMPORTANT: Must start with 'properties/' prefix, contain no forward slashes in the property_id, have no trailing slashes, and no additional path segments. Valid example: 'properties/489591273'. Invalid examples: '489591273' (missing prefix), 'properties/489591273/' (trailing slash), 'properties/489591273/extra' (extra segments)

required.name: update_mask
required.description: Required. The list of fields to be updated. Field names must be in snake case (e.g., 'display_name', 'time_zone', 'currency_code'). Omitted fields will not be updated. To replace the entire entity, use one path with the string '*' to match all fields. Common fields: 'display_name', 'time_zone', 'currency_code', 'industry_category'

optional.name: parent
optional.description: Immutable. Resource name of this property's logical parent. Format: accounts/{account}, properties/{property}. Example: 'accounts/100', 'properties/101'

optional.name: time_zone
optional.description: Required. Reporting Time Zone, used as the day boundary for reports. Format: IANA time zone. Example: 'America/Los_Angeles'

optional.name: display_name
optional.description: Human-readable display name for this property. The max allowed display name length is 100 UTF-16 code units.

optional.name: currency_code
optional.description: The currency type used in reports involving monetary values. Format: ISO 4217. Examples: 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'

optional.name: property_type
optional.description: Property type for a property.

optional.name: industry_category
optional.description: Industry category for a property.

title: Update Reply
description: Tool to update a reply to a comment on a Google Drive file. Use when you need to modify the content of an existing reply.

required.name: content
required.description: The new plain text content of the reply.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file.

required.name: reply_id
required.description: The ID of the reply.

required.name: comment_id
required.description: The ID of the comment.

optional.name: fields
optional.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. If not provided, defaults to '*' to return all fields.

title: Update send-as alias
description: Tool to update a send-as alias for a Gmail user. Use when you need to modify display name, signature, reply-to address, or SMTP settings for a send-as email address. Gmail sanitizes HTML signatures before saving. Addresses other than the primary can only be updated by service accounts with domain-wide authority.

required.name: send_as_email
required.description: The send-as alias email address to update. This is the email address that appears in the 'From:' header.

optional.name: user_id
optional.description: The email address of the Gmail user whose send-as alias to update, or the special value 'me' to indicate the authenticated user.

optional.name: smtp_msa
optional.description: SMTP relay configuration for the send-as alias.

optional.name: signature
optional.description: Optional HTML signature for messages composed with this alias in Gmail web UI. Gmail sanitizes HTML before saving. Only added to new emails.

optional.name: is_default
optional.description: Set to true to make this the default 'From:' address for composing messages and vacation auto-replies. Setting true makes the previous default false. Only legal writable value is true.

optional.name: display_name
optional.description: Name to appear in 'From:' header. For custom from addresses, Gmail populates with primary account name if empty. Admin restrictions may silently fail updates to primary login name.

optional.name: treat_as_alias
optional.description: Whether Gmail treats this address as an alias for the user's primary email. Only applies to custom from aliases.

optional.name: reply_to_address
optional.description: Optional email address for 'Reply-To:' header. Gmail omits header if empty.

title: Update Sheet Properties
description: Tool to update properties of a sheet (worksheet) within a Google Spreadsheet, such as its title, index, visibility, tab color, or grid properties. Use this when you need to modify the metadata or appearance of a specific sheet.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the spreadsheet containing the sheet to update.

required.name: update_sheet_properties
required.description: The details of the sheet properties to update.

optional.name: response_ranges
optional.description: Limits the ranges included in the response spreadsheet. Meaningful only if includeSpreadsheetInResponse is true. Ranges should be in A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:B2').

optional.name: response_include_grid_data
optional.description: True if grid data should be returned. Meaningful only if includeSpreadsheetInResponse is true. When true, the response will include cell data for the specified ranges.

optional.name: include_spreadsheet_in_response
optional.description: Determines if the update response should include the spreadsheet resource. When true, the response will include the full updated spreadsheet.

title: Update Google Meet Space
description: Updates the settings of an existing Google Meet space. Requires organizer/host privileges and the meetings.space.created OAuth scope. REQUIRED PARAMETER: - name: The space identifier (e.g., 'spaces/jQCFfuBOdN5z'). This is always required to identify which space to update. OPTIONAL PARAMETERS: - config: The new configuration settings to apply (accessType, entryPointAccess, moderation, etc.) - updateMask: Specify which fields to update. If omitted, all provided config fields are updated. Example: To change access type, provide name='spaces/abc123' and config={'accessType': 'OPEN'}

required.name: name
required.description: REQUIRED. The unique identifier of the Google Meet space to update. Format: 'spaces/{space}' where {space} is the space ID.

optional.name: config
optional.description: Configuration settings to update for the meeting space. Provide the fields you want to modify (e.g., accessType, entryPointAccess, moderation settings). Some settings (moderation modes, attendanceReportGenerationType, artifact generation) require specific Google Workspace editions and admin policies; unsupported settings may apply silently with no effect. Certain combinations of accessType, entryPointAccess, or moderation values may be rejected based on domain or account policies.

optional.name: update_mask
optional.description: Field mask specifying which fields to update. Comma-separated list of fully qualified field names (e.g., "config.accessType,config.entryPointAccess"). If not provided, only the fields you explicitly set in config will be updated. WARNING: Using "*" will attempt to update ALL config fields, which may cause errors if required fields like attendanceReportGenerationType are not provided. Recommend specifying only the fields being updated.

title: Update Spreadsheet Properties
description: Tool to update SPREADSHEET-LEVEL properties such as the spreadsheet's title, locale, time zone, or auto-recalculation settings. Use when you need to modify the overall configuration of a Google Spreadsheet. NOTE: To update individual SHEET properties (like renaming a specific sheet/tab), use GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_SHEET_PROPERTIES instead.

required.name: fields
required.description: Field mask specifying which properties to update (comma-separated for multiple fields). Supports nested paths using dot notation (e.g., 'iterativeCalculationSettings.maxIterations') per Protocol Buffers FieldMask specification. The root 'properties' is implied and must not be included. Special case: When updating 'spreadsheetTheme', use the field mask 'spreadsheetTheme' (not nested paths like 'spreadsheetTheme.primaryFontFamily') and provide the complete theme object with all required fields. Wildcard '*' updates all properties.

required.name: properties
required.description: The spreadsheet-level properties to update (e.g., title, locale, timeZone, autoRecalc). At least one field within properties must be set. NOTE: To update individual sheet/tab properties (like renaming a specific sheet), use GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_SHEET_PROPERTIES instead.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update.

optional.name: response_ranges
optional.description: Limits the ranges included in the response spreadsheet. Only meaningful if includeSpreadsheetInResponse is true. Ranges should be in A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:B2').

optional.name: response_include_grid_data
optional.description: Determines if grid data (cell values) should be included in the response. Only meaningful if includeSpreadsheetInResponse is true. When true, the response will include cell data for the specified ranges or entire spreadsheet.

optional.name: include_spreadsheet_in_response
optional.description: Determines if the update response should include the full spreadsheet resource. When true, the response will include the entire updated spreadsheet with all sheets, properties, and metadata.

title: Update Spreadsheet Values
description: Write values to one exact Google Sheets range.

required.name: range
required.description: The exact A1 notation of the range to update, such as 'Sheet1!A1:C2'.

required.name: values
required.description: Values to write. The outer list follows major_dimension. A null skips the corresponding cell; an empty string writes an empty value.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The Google Spreadsheet ID from its URL.

required.name: value_input_option
required.description: How Google Sheets interprets input: RAW stores values as supplied; USER_ENTERED parses them as if entered in the Sheets UI.

optional.name: major_dimension
optional.description: Whether each inner values list represents a row or a column.

optional.name: include_values_in_response
optional.description: Whether the response should include the resulting cell values in updated_data.

optional.name: response_value_render_option
optional.description: How returned values are rendered when include_values_in_response is true.

optional.name: response_date_time_render_option
optional.description: How returned dates, times, and durations are rendered when values are unformatted.

title: Update Table Row Style
description: Tool to update the style of a table row in a Google Document. Use when you need to modify the appearance of specific rows within a table, such as setting minimum row height or marking rows as headers.

required.name: document_id
required.description: The ID of the document to update.

required.name: update_table_row_style
required.description: The request body for updating the table row style.

title: Update Tab Properties
description: Updates properties of a document tab such as title, parent tab, index, and icon emoji. Use this action when you need to rename a tab, change its emoji icon, move it within the tab hierarchy, or reorganize tab structure.

required.name: tab_id
required.description: The ID of the tab to update. Get valid tab IDs from GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_BY_ID at tabs[].tabProperties.tabId.

required.name: document_id
required.description: The ID of the document containing the tab to update.

required.name: tab_properties
required.description: The tab properties to update. Only the fields specified in the 'fields' parameter will be updated.

optional.name: fields
optional.description: A comma-separated list of fields to update (using camelCase API names like 'title', 'parentTabId', 'index', 'iconEmoji'). Use '*' to automatically update only fields that have values set in tab_properties. For example: 'title,iconEmoji'. When '*' is specified, the action automatically computes the field mask from the provided tab_properties fields.

title: Update Task (Full Replacement)
description: Tool to fully replace an existing Google Task using PUT method. Use when you need to update the entire task resource, not just specific fields. This method requires all required fields (id, title) and replaces the complete task, unlike PATCH which supports partial updates.

required.name: id
required.description: Task identifier (REQUIRED). Must match the task_id parameter. This field is required by the Google Tasks API for PUT operations.

required.name: title
required.description: Title/name of the task (REQUIRED). This is the main text displayed for the task. Maximum 1024 characters.

required.name: task_id
required.description: Identifier of the Google Task to be fully replaced within the specified task list. This must also be included in the 'id' field of the request body.

required.name: tasklist_id
required.description: Identifier of the Google Task list that contains the task to be updated.

optional.name: due
optional.description: Due date for the task. NOTE: Google Tasks only stores the date portion (YYYY-MM-DD). Accepts RFC3339 format (e.g., '2025-09-28T00:00:00Z') or date strings like '2025-09-28'.

optional.name: etag
optional.description: ETag of the resource for concurrency control. Prevents accidental overwrites when multiple clients modify the same task.

optional.name: links
optional.description: Collection of links attached to the task. This collection is read-only.

optional.name: notes
optional.description: Additional details or description for the task. Supports plain text only. Maximum 8192 characters.

optional.name: hidden
optional.description: Whether the task is hidden. This is read-only and set by the API when task list is cleared. Default: false

optional.name: parent
optional.description: Parent task identifier for subtasks. This field is read-only. Use the 'move' method to change parent.

optional.name: status
optional.description: Current status of the task. Must be either 'needsAction' (task is pending) or 'completed' (task is done).

optional.name: deleted
optional.description: Whether the task has been deleted. Deleted tasks are marked but not immediately removed. Default: false

optional.name: position
optional.description: Position of the task among siblings. This field is read-only. Use the 'move' method to change position.

optional.name: completed
optional.description: Date/time when the task was marked as completed. Only applicable when status='completed'. Unlike 'due', this field preserves the time component. Accepts RFC3339 format.

title: Update Task List
description: Updates the authenticated user's specified task list.

required.name: title
required.description: Title of the task list. Maximum length allowed: 1024 characters.

required.name: tasklist_id
required.description: Task list identifier.

title: Update Vacation Settings
description: Tool to update vacation responder settings for a Gmail user. Use when you need to configure out-of-office auto-replies.

required.name: response_subject
required.description: Optional text to prepend to the subject line in vacation responses. In order to enable auto-replies, either the response subject or the response body must be nonempty.

optional.name: user_id
optional.description: The user's email address. The special value 'me' can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

optional.name: end_time
optional.description: An optional end time for sending auto-replies (epoch ms). When this is specified, Gmail will automatically reply only to messages that it receives before the end time. If both startTime and endTime are specified, startTime must precede endTime.

optional.name: start_time
optional.description: An optional start time for sending auto-replies (epoch ms). When this is specified, Gmail will automatically reply only to messages that it receives after the start time. If both startTime and endTime are specified, startTime must precede endTime.

optional.name: enable_auto_reply
optional.description: Flag that controls whether Gmail automatically replies to messages.

optional.name: response_body_html
optional.description: Response body in HTML format. Gmail will sanitize the HTML before storing it. If both response_body_plain_text and response_body_html are specified, response_body_html will be used.

optional.name: restrict_to_domain
optional.description: Flag that determines whether responses are sent to recipients who are outside of the user's domain. This feature is only available for Google Workspace users.

optional.name: restrict_to_contacts
optional.description: Flag that determines whether responses are sent to recipients who are not in the user's list of contacts.

optional.name: response_body_plain_text
optional.description: Response body in plain text format. If both response_body_plain_text and response_body_html are specified, response_body_html will be used.

title: Batch update spreadsheet values
description: Tool to set values in one or more ranges of a spreadsheet. Use when you need to update multiple ranges in a single operation for better performance.

required.name: data
required.description: The new values to apply to the spreadsheet. Each ValueRange specifies a range and the values to write to that range. Multiple ranges can be updated in a single request.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. This ID can be found in the URL of the spreadsheet (e.g., https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{spreadsheet_id}/edit). Must be a valid Google Sheets spreadsheet ID.

required.name: value_input_option
required.description: How the input data should be interpreted. RAW: Values are stored exactly as entered, without parsing. USER_ENTERED: Values are parsed as if typed by a user (numbers stay numbers, strings prefixed with '=' become formulas, etc.). INPUT_VALUE_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED: Default input value option is not specified.

optional.name: include_values_in_response
optional.description: Determines if the update response should include the values of the cells that were updated. By default, responses do not include the updated values.

optional.name: response_value_render_option
optional.description: Determines how values in the response should be rendered. Only used if includeValuesInResponse is true. FORMATTED_VALUE (default): Values are formatted as displayed in the UI. UNFORMATTED_VALUE: Values are unformatted. FORMULA: Formulas are not evaluated.

optional.name: response_date_time_render_option
optional.description: Determines how dates, times, and durations in the response should be rendered. Only used if includeValuesInResponse is true. SERIAL_NUMBER (default): Dates are returned as numbers. FORMATTED_STRING: Dates are returned as formatted strings.

title: Upload File
description: Uploads a file (max 5MB) to Google Drive, placing it in the specified folder or root if no valid folder ID is provided. Always creates a new file (never updates existing); use GOOGLEDRIVE_EDIT_FILE to update with a stable file_id. Uploaded files are private by default; configure sharing via GOOGLEDRIVE_ADD_FILE_SHARING_PREFERENCE.

required.name: file_to_upload
required.description: File to upload to Google Drive (max 5MB). Use a clear filename and accurate MIME type, for example `application/pdf`; incorrect values can cause Drive to convert or misrender the file.

optional.name: folder_to_upload_to
optional.description: Optional ID of the target Google Drive folder; can be obtained using 'Find Folder' or similar actions. Invalid or missing IDs silently fall back to Drive root with no error — resolve the correct folder ID first using GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE.

title: Upload File from URL to Drive
description: Tool to fetch a file from a provided URL server-side and upload it into Google Drive. Use when you need to reliably persist externally hosted files into Drive without client-side downloads or temporary storage.

required.name: name
required.description: Name for the file in Google Drive, including extension (e.g., 'report.pdf', 'image.png').

required.name: source_url
required.description: HTTPS URL of the file to download and upload to Google Drive. Must be publicly accessible or include necessary authentication in source_headers.

optional.name: mime_type
optional.description: Target MIME type for the file in Google Drive. If not specified, Drive auto-detects from content. Google Workspace MIME types (application/vnd.google-apps.*) trigger automatic conversion from compatible source formats: google-apps.document converts Word/ODT/HTML/RTF/TXT/PDF/images (OCR); google-apps.spreadsheet converts Excel/ODS/CSV/TSV; google-apps.presentation converts PowerPoint/ODP. Conversion requires the source content to be in a compatible format. Incompatible formats will cause upload errors.

optional.name: verify_ssl
optional.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates when downloading from HTTPS URLs. Set to false to bypass SSL verification for URLs with certificate issues (expired certificates, hostname mismatches, self-signed certificates). Only disable for trusted sources.

optional.name: source_headers
optional.description: Optional HTTP headers to include when downloading from source_url. Use for authentication tokens, signed URLs, or CDN-specific headers.

optional.name: parent_folder_id
optional.description: ID of the parent folder in Google Drive. If not specified, the file will be uploaded to the root of My Drive.

optional.name: supports_all_drives
optional.description: Whether the request supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true for broader compatibility.

title: Upload Media
description: Upload a media file to Google Photos. Supports images (up to 200MB) and videos (up to 20GB).

optional.name: url
optional.description: Public URL of the media file to upload (must be directly accessible). The action will download the file from this URL and upload it to Google Photos. Alternative to 'file_to_upload'. Supported formats: images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, HEIC, etc.) and videos (MP4, MOV, etc.).

optional.name: file_name
optional.description: File name for the uploaded media. Required when using 'url' parameter. Should include the file extension (e.g., 'photo.jpg', 'video.mp4').

optional.name: description
optional.description: Optional description for the media item

optional.name: file_to_upload
optional.description: The media file to upload to Google Photos.

title: Upload/Update File Content
description: Tool to update file content in Google Drive by uploading new binary content. Use when you need to replace the contents of an existing file with new file data.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file to update with new content.

required.name: file_to_upload
required.description: The file content to upload.

optional.name: add_parents
optional.description: Comma-separated list of parent folder IDs to add.

optional.name: upload_type
optional.description: The type of upload request. 'media' for simple upload (content only), 'multipart' for metadata + content, 'resumable' for large files.

optional.name: ocr_language
optional.description: Language hint for OCR processing (ISO 639-1 code, e.g., 'en').

optional.name: remove_parents
optional.description: Comma-separated list of parent folder IDs to remove.

optional.name: supports_all_drives
optional.description: Whether the app supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true.

optional.name: keep_revision_forever
optional.description: Whether to set the 'keepForever' field in the new head revision.

optional.name: use_content_as_indexable_text
optional.description: Whether to use the uploaded content as indexable text for search.

title: Upsert Rows (Smart Update/Insert)
description: Upsert rows - update existing rows by key, append new ones. Automatically handles column mapping and partial updates. Use for: CRM syncs (match Lead ID), transaction imports (match Transaction ID), inventory updates (match SKU), calendar syncs (match Event ID). Features: - Auto-adds missing columns to sheet - Partial column updates (only update Phone + Status, preserve other columns) - Column order doesn't matter (auto-maps by header name) - Prevents duplicates by matching key column Example inputs: - Contact update: keyColumn='Email', headers=['Email','Phone','Status'], data=[['john@ex.com','555-0101','Active']] - Inventory sync: keyColumn='SKU', headers=['SKU','Stock','Price'], data=[['WIDGET-001',50,9.99],['GADGET-002',30,19.99]] - CRM lead update: keyColumn='Lead ID', headers=['Lead ID','Score','Status'], data=[['L-12345',85,'Hot']] - Partial update: keyColumn='Email', headers=['Email','Phone'] (only updates Phone, preserves Name/Address/etc)

required.name: rows
required.description: 2D array of data rows to upsert. IMPORTANT: If 'headers' is NOT provided, the FIRST row is treated as column headers and remaining rows as data - so you need at least 2 rows (1 header + 1 data). If 'headers' IS provided separately, then ALL rows in this array are treated as data rows. Each row should have the same number of values as headers. If a row has MORE values than headers: with strict_mode=true (default), an error is returned showing which rows are affected; with strict_mode=false, extra values are silently truncated. If a row has FEWER values than headers, an error is returned during execution. Cell values can be strings, numbers, booleans, or null. Example with headers provided: headers=['Email','Status'], rows=[['john@ex.com','Active']] (1 data row). Example without headers: rows=[['Email','Status'],['john@ex.com','Active']] (row 1 = headers, row 2 = data).

required.name: sheet_name
required.description: The name of the sheet/tab within the spreadsheet. Note: Google Sheets creates default sheets with localized names based on account language (e.g., 'Sheet1' for English, '工作表1' for Chinese, 'Hoja1' for Spanish, 'Feuille1' for French, 'Planilha1' for Portuguese, 'Лист1' for Russian). If you specify a common default name and the sheet is not found, the action will automatically use the first sheet if only one exists.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the spreadsheet. Must be a non-empty string, typically a 44-character alphanumeric string found in the spreadsheet URL.

optional.name: headers
optional.description: List of column names for the data. These will be matched against sheet headers. If a column doesn't exist in the sheet, it will be added automatically. Order doesn't need to match sheet order. Can be auto-derived from the first row in 'rows' if not provided. Example inputs: ['Email', 'Phone', 'Status'] for contact updates, ['Lead ID', 'Name', 'Score'] for CRM, ['SKU', 'Stock', 'Price'] for inventory.

optional.name: key_column
optional.description: The column NAME (header text) to use as unique identifier for matching rows. Must be an actual header name from the sheet (e.g., 'Email', 'Lead ID', 'SKU'), NOT a column letter (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C'). If you provide a column letter like 'A', it will be automatically converted to the header name at that column position. If neither 'key_column' nor 'key_column_index' is provided, defaults to the first column (index 0).

optional.name: strict_mode
optional.description: Controls how rows with mismatched column counts are handled. When True (default), an error is returned if any row has more values than headers - the error message shows exactly which rows are affected and what values would need to be removed. When False, extra values are silently truncated to match the header count. Set to False only if you explicitly want automatic truncation of extra values.

optional.name: table_start
optional.description: Cell where the table starts (where headers are located). Defaults to 'A1'. Use this if your table is offset (e.g., 'C5', 'D10').

optional.name: key_column_index
optional.description: The 0-based column index to use as unique identifier for matching rows. Alternative to 'key_column' - will be converted to column name using headers. If neither 'key_column' nor 'key_column_index' is provided, defaults to 0 (first column). Example: 0 for first column, 1 for second column.

optional.name: normalization_message
optional.description: Internal field to track input normalization (e.g., row truncation). Not part of API.

title: Validate Events
description: Tool to validate Measurement Protocol events before sending them to production. Use when you need to verify event structure and parameters are correct before sending real data.

required.name: events
required.description: Required. Array of events to validate. Each event must have a 'name' field and optional 'params' object.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Required. Unique client identifier. This uniquely identifies a user instance of a web client.

required.name: api_secret
required.description: Required. The API secret from Google Analytics for the Measurement Protocol.

required.name: measurement_id
required.description: Required. The measurement ID for web streams. Format: G-XXXXXXXXXX where X is alphanumeric.

optional.name: consent
optional.description: Optional. The consent state for the user.

optional.name: user_id
optional.description: Optional. A unique identifier for a user.

optional.name: user_properties
optional.description: Optional. The user properties for the measurement.

optional.name: timestamp_micros
optional.description: Optional. A Unix timestamp (in microseconds) for the time to associate with the event.

title: Get spreadsheet values
description: Returns a range of values from a spreadsheet. Use when you need to read data from specific cells or ranges in a Google Sheet.

required.name: range
required.description: The A1 notation or R1C1 notation of the range to retrieve values from. If the sheet name contains spaces or special characters, wrap the sheet name in single quotes (e.g., "'My Sheet'!A1:B2"). Without single quotes, the API will return a 400 error for sheet names with spaces. Examples: 'Sheet1!A1:B3', "'Sheet With Spaces'!A1:D5", 'A1:D5' (no sheet name uses first visible sheet), 'Sheet1!A:A' (entire column), 'SheetName' (entire sheet).

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the Google Spreadsheet from which to retrieve values. This is the long alphanumeric string found in the spreadsheet URL between '/d/' and '/edit' (e.g., '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms'). WARNING: Do NOT use the spreadsheet name or title (e.g., 'My Sales Report'); you must use the actual ID from the URL.

optional.name: end_row
optional.description: 1-based row number to stop reading at (inclusive). Use with start_row for pagination to avoid large response errors. Example: start_row=501, end_row=1000 fetches rows 501-1000.

optional.name: start_row
optional.description: 1-based row number to start reading from (inclusive). Use with end_row for pagination to avoid large response errors. Example: start_row=1, end_row=500 fetches the first 500 rows.

optional.name: major_dimension
optional.description: The major dimension for results.

optional.name: value_render_option
optional.description: How values should be rendered in the output. FORMATTED_VALUE: Values are calculated and formatted (default). UNFORMATTED_VALUE: Values are calculated but not formatted. FORMULA: Values are not calculated; the formula is returned instead.

optional.name: date_time_render_option
optional.description: How dates, times, and durations should be represented in the output. SERIAL_NUMBER: Dates are returned as serial numbers (default). FORMATTED_STRING: Dates returned as formatted strings.

title: Update spreadsheet values
description: Tool to set values in a range of a Google Spreadsheet. Use when you need to update or overwrite existing cell values in a specific range.

required.name: range
required.description: The A1 notation of the range to update values in (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:C2', 'MySheet!C:C', or 'A1:D5'). Must be actual cell references, not placeholder values. If the sheet name is omitted (e.g., 'A1:B2'), the operation applies to the first visible sheet. IMPORTANT: The range must not exceed the sheet's grid dimensions. By default, new sheets have 1000 rows and 26 columns (A-Z). If you need to write to columns beyond Z (e.g., AA, AB), first expand the sheet using GOOGLESHEETS_APPEND_DIMENSION or check the current dimensions using GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO.

required.name: values
required.description: The data to write. This is an array of arrays, the outer array representing all the data and each inner array representing a major dimension. Each item in the inner array corresponds with one cell.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the Google Spreadsheet to update. This ID can be found in the URL of the spreadsheet (e.g., https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{spreadsheet_id}/edit). Must be a non-empty string.

required.name: value_input_option
required.description: How the input data should be interpreted. RAW: Values are stored exactly as entered, without parsing (dates, formulas, etc. remain as strings). USER_ENTERED: Values are parsed as if typed by a user (numbers stay numbers, strings prefixed with '=' become formulas, etc.).

optional.name: major_dimension
optional.description: The major dimension of the values. ROWS (default) means each inner array is a row of values. COLUMNS means each inner array is a column of values. Defaults to ROWS if unspecified.

optional.name: auto_expand_sheet
optional.description: If True (default), automatically expands the sheet's dimensions (adds columns/rows) when the target range exceeds the current grid limits. If False, the operation will fail with an error if the range exceeds grid limits.

optional.name: include_values_in_response
optional.description: Determines if the update response should include the values of the cells that were updated. By default, responses do not include the updated values.

optional.name: response_value_render_option
optional.description: Determines how values in the response should be rendered. Only used if includeValuesInResponse is true. FORMATTED_VALUE (default): Values are formatted as displayed in the UI. UNFORMATTED_VALUE: Values are unformatted (numbers, booleans, formulas). FORMULA: Formulas are not evaluated and remain as text.

optional.name: response_datetime_render_option
optional.description: Determines how dates, times, and durations in the response should be rendered. Only used if includeValuesInResponse is true. SERIAL_NUMBER (default): Dates are returned as numbers. FORMATTED_STRING: Dates are returned as strings formatted per the cell's locale.

title: Watch Drive Changes
description: Tool to subscribe to changes for a user or shared drive in Google Drive. Use when you need to monitor a Google Drive for modifications and receive notifications at a specified webhook URL. Notifications may be batched rather than per-change; design handlers to be idempotent and fetch all changes since the last known page_token on each notification.

required.name: id
required.description: A unique string that identifies this channel. UUIDs are recommended. Must be unique per active channel; reusing an ID can cause missed, delayed, or duplicate notifications.

required.name: type
required.description: The type of delivery mechanism for notifications.

required.name: address
required.description: The URL where notifications are to be delivered. Must be a publicly reachable HTTPS URL with a valid SSL certificate; HTTP, localhost, and private network endpoints are rejected by the API.

optional.name: token
optional.description: An arbitrary string that will be delivered with each notification. Can be used for verification.

optional.name: params
optional.description:
Optional parameters for the notification channel.
Example: {"ttl": "3600"} for a 1-hour time-to-live (actual support depends on Google API).

optional.name: spaces
optional.description: A comma-separated list of spaces to query within the corpora. Supported values are 'drive' and 'appDataFolder'.

optional.name: drive_id
optional.description: The shared drive from which changes will be returned. If specified, change IDs will be specific to the shared drive.

optional.name: page_size
optional.description: The maximum number of changes to return per page.

optional.name: expiration
optional.description: Timestamp in milliseconds since the epoch for when the channel should expire. If not set, channel may not expire or have a default expiration. Channels are invalidated after expiry; re-establish the watch with a new channel before or after expiration to avoid missed changes.

optional.name: page_token
optional.description: The token for continuing a previous list request on the next page. This should be set to the value of 'nextPageToken' from the previous response or to the response from the getStartPageToken method. Persist this token per channel so change processing can resume correctly after restarts or interruptions.

optional.name: include_labels
optional.description: A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the labelInfo part of the response.

optional.name: include_removed
optional.description: Whether to include changes indicating that items have been removed from the list of changes (e.g., by deletion or loss of access).

optional.name: supports_all_drives
optional.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Recommended to set to true if driveId is used or if interactions with shared drives are expected.

optional.name: restrict_to_my_drive
optional.description: Whether to restrict the results to changes inside the My Drive hierarchy. This omits changes to files like those in the Application Data folder or shared files not added to My Drive.

optional.name: include_corpus_removals
optional.description: Whether changes should include the file resource if the file is still accessible by the user at the time of the request, even when a file was removed from the list of changes.

optional.name: include_permissions_for_view
optional.description: Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response.

optional.name: include_items_from_all_drives
optional.description: Whether both My Drive and shared drive items should be included in results.

title: Watch File for Changes
description: Tool to subscribe to push notifications for changes to a specific file. Use when you need to monitor a file for modifications and receive real-time notifications at a webhook URL.

required.name: id
required.description: A UUID or similar unique string that identifies this notification channel (max 64 characters).

required.name: type
required.description: The type of delivery mechanism used for this channel.

required.name: file_id
required.description: The ID of the file to watch for changes.

required.name: address
required.description: The HTTPS address where notifications are delivered for this channel. Must have a valid SSL certificate.

optional.name: token
optional.description: An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification for verification (max 256 characters).

optional.name: params
optional.description: Additional parameters controlling delivery channel behavior.

optional.name: payload
optional.description: Whether payload data should be included in notifications.

optional.name: expiration
optional.description: Date and time of notification channel expiration as Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Default: 3600 seconds, max: 86400 seconds for files.

optional.name: include_labels
optional.description: A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the labelInfo part of the response.

optional.name: acknowledge_abuse
optional.description: Whether the user is acknowledging the risk of downloading known malware or other abusive files. Only applicable to file owner/organizer.

optional.name: supports_all_drives
optional.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives.

optional.name: supports_team_drives
optional.description: Deprecated. Use supportsAllDrives instead.

optional.name: include_permissions_for_view
optional.description: Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response.

title: Who Am I
description: Return the identity (email, name) of the connected Gmail account.

title: Write Spreadsheet Values
description: Replace values in one range of a Google spreadsheet.

required.name: range
required.description: The A1 notation range whose values to replace, such as 'Sheet1!A1:B2'.

required.name: values
required.description: A matrix of string, number, boolean, or null cell values. Each inner list follows major_dimension.

required.name: spreadsheet_id
required.description: The ID of the Google spreadsheet to update.

required.name: value_input_option
required.description: Required interpretation mode. RAW stores values as supplied; USER_ENTERED parses them as if entered in Google Sheets.

optional.name: major_dimension
optional.description: How the values matrix is oriented. Defaults to ROWS when omitted.

optional.name: include_values_in_response
optional.description: Whether the response should include the values written in updatedData.

optional.name: response_value_render_option
optional.description: How values in updatedData are rendered when updated values are included.

optional.name: response_date_time_render_option
optional.description: How dates, times, and durations in updatedData are rendered when updated values are included.

title: Abort Repository Migration
description: Tool to abort a repository migration that is queued or in progress. Use when you need to cancel an ongoing migration operation.

required.name: migration_id
required.description: The ID of the repository migration to abort. This is the migration ID returned when a migration was queued (e.g., 'RM_kgDOABCDEF').

optional.name: client_mutation_id
optional.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation. This can be used to track the mutation in logs or for idempotency purposes.

title: Accept a repository invitation
description: Accepts a PENDING repository invitation that has been issued to the authenticated user.

required.name: invitation_id
required.description: Unique identifier of the repository invitation sent TO the authenticated user. Get this ID by listing your pending invitations using the 'List repository invitations for the authenticated user' action.

title: Add app access restrictions
description: Adds GitHub Apps to the list of apps allowed to push to a protected branch. The branch must already have protection rules with restrictions enabled. This endpoint only works for organization repositories, not personal repositories. Apps must be installed on the repository with 'contents' write permissions.

required.name: apps
required.description: The list of GitHub App slugs with push access to grant. Apps must be installed on the repository and have 'contents' write permissions. The app slug is the URL-friendly name of the GitHub App (e.g., 'github-actions', 'dependabot').

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This field is not case-sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The organization name that owns the repository. This field is not case-sensitive. Note: This endpoint only works for organization-owned repositories.

required.name: branch
required.description: The name of the branch to which restrictions will be applied. Wildcard characters (e.g., '*') are not allowed in the branch name when using this REST API endpoint. For operations involving wildcard branch names, consult the GitHub GraphQL API.

title: Add a repository collaborator
description: Adds a GitHub user as a repository collaborator, or updates their permission if already a collaborator; `permission` applies to organization-owned repositories (personal ones default to 'push' and ignore this field), and an invitation may be created or permissions updated directly.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository. This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: username
required.description: The GitHub handle for the user account to add as a collaborator. Cannot be the same as the repository owner, as owners are automatically collaborators.

optional.name: permission
optional.description: Permission level for the collaborator. For organization-owned repositories, valid values are `pull` (read-only), `triage` (manage issues/PRs), `push` (read/write), `maintain` (manage most settings), `admin` (full control), or a custom repository role name if defined by the owning organization. This parameter is ignored for personal repositories, which grant `push` access.

title: Add assignees to an issue
description: Adds assignees to a GitHub issue. This action only adds users - it does not remove existing assignees. Changes are silently ignored if the authenticated user lacks push access to the repository.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This field is not case sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The username of the account or the organization name that owns the repository. This field is not case sensitive.

required.name: issue_number
required.description: The unique number identifying the issue within the repository. Must be a positive integer (GitHub issue numbers start at 1).

optional.name: assignees
optional.description: A list of GitHub usernames to add as assignees to the issue. Up to 10 assignees total can be on an issue. NOTE: This endpoint ADDS assignees - it does not replace existing ones. Users already assigned are kept. To remove assignees, use the 'remove_assignees_from_an_issue' action instead. The authenticated user must have push access to the repository; otherwise changes are silently ignored.

title: Add email for auth user
description: Adds one or more email addresses (which will be initially unverified) to the authenticated user's GitHub account; use this to associate new emails, noting an email verified for another account will error, while an existing email for the current user is accepted.

required.name: emails
required.description: Array of email addresses to add to the authenticated user account. Must contain at least one email address.

title: Add field to user project
description: Tool to add a custom field to a user-owned GitHub Projects V2 project. Use when you need to add fields like status, priority, or custom data to organize project items.

required.name: name
required.description: The name of the field to create.

required.name: username
required.description: The handle for the GitHub user account.

required.name: data_type
required.description: The data type of the field. Use 'single_select' for dropdown fields, 'iteration' for sprint fields, or other types for simple fields.

required.name: project_number
required.description: The project's number.

optional.name: single_select_options
optional.description: Options for single select fields. Required when data_type is 'single_select'.

optional.name: iteration_configuration
optional.description: Configuration for iteration fields.

title: Add item to user project
description: Tool to add an issue or pull request to a user-owned GitHub project. Use when you need to add existing repository items to a project board.

required.name: type
required.description: The type of item to add to the project. Must be either Issue or PullRequest.

required.name: username
required.description: The handle for the GitHub user account.

required.name: project_number
required.description: The project's number.

optional.name: id
optional.description: The unique identifier of the issue or pull request to add to the project. Required if owner, repo, and number are not provided.

optional.name: repo
optional.description: The repository name. Required with owner and number if id is not provided.

optional.name: owner
optional.description: The repository owner login. Required with repo and number if id is not provided.

optional.name: number
optional.description: The issue or pull request number. Required with owner and repo if id is not provided.

title: Add labels to an issue
description: Adds labels (provided in the request body) to a repository issue; labels that do not already exist are created.

required.name: repo
required.description: Repository name, without the `.git` extension (case-insensitive).

required.name: owner
required.description: Username or organization name owning the repository (case-insensitive).

required.name: labels
required.description: Array of label names to add to the issue. Labels that don't exist will be created automatically.

required.name: issue_number
required.description: Positive integer that uniquely identifies the issue within the repository. Must be >= 1.

title: Add org runner labels
description: Adds new custom labels to an existing self-hosted runner for an organization; existing labels are not removed, and duplicates are not added.

required.name: org
required.description: The organization's name (case-insensitive).

required.name: labels
required.description: A list of custom label names to add to the self-hosted runner. Previously applied labels are not removed.

required.name: runner_id
required.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner.

title: Add or update team membership for a user
description: Adds a GitHub user to a team or updates their role (member or maintainer), inviting them to the organization if not already a member; idempotent, returning current details if no change is made.

required.name: org
required.description: The name of the GitHub organization. This name is not case-sensitive.

required.name: username
required.description: The GitHub username of the user to add or whose membership to update.

required.name: team_slug
required.description: The slug (URL-friendly version) of the team's name. Must be lowercase with hyphens instead of spaces (e.g., 'my-team' not 'My Team'). Spaces will be automatically converted to hyphens and text will be lowercased.

optional.name: role
optional.description: The role to assign to the user within the team. A 'maintainer' has broader permissions than a 'member', such as managing team members and settings.

title: Add or update team project permissions
description: Adds a classic project to a team or updates the team's permission on it. This endpoint grants or updates permissions for a team on a specific classic project (not Projects V2). The authenticated user must have admin permissions for the project. Both the team and project must belong to the same organization. Requirements: - The project must be a classic project (not GitHub Projects V2) - The authenticated user must have admin permissions on the project - The team and project must be in the same organization - Requires 'admin:org' scope for the authentication token Returns HTTP 204 No Content on success, 403 if project is not an org project, or 404 if the organization, team, or project is not found.

required.name: org
required.description: The organization name (login) that owns both the team and the classic project. Case-insensitive.

required.name: team_slug
required.description: The team's URL-friendly slug identifier within the organization. Found in the team's URL path.

required.name: project_id
required.description: The unique numeric ID of the classic project. This is NOT the project number displayed in the UI.

optional.name: permission
optional.description: Permission level to grant the team: 'read' (view only), 'write' (view and edit), or 'admin' (full control including settings). If omitted, uses the team's default permission.

title: Add or update team repository permissions
description: Sets or updates a team's permission level for a repository within an organization; the team must be a member of the organization.

required.name: org
required.description: Organization name where the team exists (case-insensitive). This is the organization that owns the team, not necessarily the repository owner.

required.name: repo
required.description: Repository name, without the `.git` extension (case-insensitive).

required.name: owner
required.description: Account owner of the repository (case-insensitive). This is the user or organization that owns the repository. In most cases, this should match the 'org' parameter value.

required.name: team_slug
required.description: The team's slug (URL-friendly name).

optional.name: permission
optional.description: Permission level to grant the team. Valid values: 'pull' (read-only), 'triage' (manage issues/PRs), 'push' (read/write), 'maintain' (manage repo settings plus push), 'admin' (full control). Custom repository role names are also supported if defined by the organization.

title: Add a repository to an app installation
description: Adds a repository to a GitHub App installation, granting the app access; requires authenticated user to have admin rights for the repository and access to the installation.

required.name: repository_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the repository to add to the installation. The authenticated user must have admin permissions for this repository.

required.name: installation_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the GitHub App installation to which the repository will be added. This installation must be accessible to the authenticated user.

title: Add repo to org secret with selected access
description: Adds a repository to an existing organization-level GitHub Actions secret that is configured for 'selected' repository access.

required.name: org
required.description: The name of the GitHub organization. This field is not case-sensitive.

required.name: secret_name
required.description: The name of the organization secret to which the repository will be added.

required.name: repository_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the repository to be granted access to the organization secret.

title: Add selected repo to org secret
description: Grants an existing repository access to an existing organization-level Dependabot secret when the secret's visibility is set to 'selected'; the repository must belong to the organization, and the call succeeds without change if access already exists.

required.name: org
required.description: The organization's unique handle/name (case-insensitive).

required.name: secret_name
required.description: Name of the Dependabot secret; must be alphanumeric or underscore, no spaces (lowercase auto-converts to uppercase).

required.name: repository_id
required.description: Unique ID of the repository to be granted access to the secret.

title: Add runner labels
description: Adds and appends custom labels to a self-hosted repository runner, which must be registered and active.

required.name: repo
required.description: Name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. Case-insensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: Username or organization name of the repository owner. Case-insensitive.

required.name: labels
required.description: Custom label names to add. Appended to existing labels. Names are case-insensitive. Empty list means no changes.

required.name: runner_id
required.description: Unique ID of the self-hosted runner.

title: Add selected repository to an organization secret
description: Adds a repository to an organization secret's access list when the secret's visibility is 'selected'; this operation is idempotent.

required.name: org
required.description: The name of the organization. This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: secret_name
required.description: The name of the secret. Secret names can only contain alphanumeric characters ([A-Z], [a-z], [0-9]) or underscores (_). Spaces are not allowed. Secret names cannot start with GITHUB_ and must be less than 255 characters.

required.name: repository_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the repository to add to the secret's access list.

title: Add selected repository to an organization variable
description: Grants a repository access to an organization-level GitHub Actions variable, if that variable's visibility is set to 'selected_repositories'.

required.name: org
required.description: Name of the GitHub organization (case-insensitive).

required.name: name
required.description: Name of the existing organization-level GitHub Actions variable.

required.name: repository_id
required.description: Unique identifier of the repository to grant access.

title: Add a selected repository to a user secret
description: Grants a specified repository access to an authenticated user's existing Codespaces secret, enabling Codespaces created for that repository to use the secret.

required.name: secret_name
required.description: Name of the user-level Codespaces secret to which repository access is added; this secret must already exist for the authenticated user.

required.name: repository_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the repository to be granted access to the specified user-level Codespaces secret.

title: Add social accounts for the authenticated user
description: Adds one or more social media links (which must be valid, full URLs for platforms supported by GitHub) to the authenticated user's public GitHub profile.

required.name: account_urls
required.description: Full URLs for social media profiles to add to the user's GitHub profile; these will be displayed publicly.

title: Add status check contexts
description: Adds status check contexts to a protected branch's required status checks. This action appends new status check contexts to the existing list of required status checks for a protected branch. The branch must already have branch protection enabled with status checks configured. Note: The 'contexts' parameter is deprecated by GitHub in favor of 'checks' array. For new implementations, consider using update_status_check_protection with the 'checks' parameter instead.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository. This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: branch
required.description: The name of the branch to which status check contexts will be added. Branch names cannot contain wildcard characters. To use wildcard characters in branch names, refer to the GraphQL API.

required.name: contexts
required.description: The status check contexts to add to the protected branch. These are the names of CI/CD jobs or other checks that must pass before merging. Can be provided as a single string or a list of strings. Examples: 'ci/test', 'linter', 'continuous-integration/travis-ci'.

title: Add sub-issue to an issue
description: Tool to add a sub-issue to a parent GitHub issue using GraphQL. Use when you need to establish a parent-child relationship between issues. Requires the 'sub_issues' GraphQL feature to be enabled.

required.name: issue_id
required.description: The global node ID of the parent issue (e.g., 'I_kwDOABCDEFGH'). This is the GraphQL global identifier returned by GitHub's API.

required.name: sub_issue_id
required.description: The global node ID of the sub-issue to link to the parent issue. Either sub_issue_id or sub_issue_url must be provided.

required.name: sub_issue_url
required.description: The URL of the sub-issue to link to the parent issue. Either sub_issue_id or sub_issue_url must be provided.

optional.name: replace_parent
optional.description: If true, replaces the existing parent issue if the sub-issue already has one. If false or omitted, the mutation will fail if the sub-issue already has a parent.

optional.name: client_mutation_id
optional.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation. Used to ensure idempotency of mutations.

title: Add team access restrictions
description: Adds teams to the list of teams with push access to a protected branch. This action grants additional teams push access to a protected branch. Unlike 'Set team access restrictions' (PUT), this action adds to the existing list rather than replacing it entirely. Prerequisites: - The repository must be owned by an organization (not a personal account) - The branch must have protection rules enabled - The branch protection must have restrictions configured - The teams must exist in the organization and have repository access

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This value is not case-sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The organization name that owns the repository. Team access restrictions only work for organization-owned repositories, not personal repositories. This value is not case-sensitive.

required.name: teams
required.description: The list of team slugs to add push access to the protected branch. A team slug is the URL-friendly version of the team name (lowercase, hyphens instead of spaces). The teams must already have access to the repository. This adds teams to the existing list (does not replace the entire list).

required.name: branch
required.description: The name of the protected branch to add team restrictions to. The branch must already have branch protection enabled with restrictions configured. Wildcard characters are not supported. For wildcard branch protection, use the GitHub GraphQL API.

title: Add user access restrictions
description: Adds users to the list of people allowed to push to a protected branch in an organization repository. Important notes: - This action only works on organization-owned repositories (not personal repos) - The branch must already have protection rules with restrictions enabled - Users must have write access to the repository to be added - The combined total of users, apps, and teams is limited to 100 items

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This name is not case-sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository (must be an organization for user restrictions). This name is not case-sensitive.

required.name: users
required.description: The list of user logins to grant push access to the protected branch. Users must have write access to the repository. An empty list will remove all user restrictions.

required.name: branch
required.description: The name of the branch. Cannot contain wildcard characters. To use wildcard characters in branch names, refer to the GitHub GraphQL API documentation.

title: Add users to codespaces access for an organization
