required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

required.name: asset_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the release asset to be updated.

optional.name: name
optional.description: The new file name for the asset. This updates the display name of the asset.

optional.name: label
optional.description: An alternate short description for the asset. This is used in place of the filename if provided, offering a more descriptive label.

optional.name: state
optional.description: The new state of the release asset. While the GitHub API documentation primarily shows 'state' in responses (e.g., 'uploaded'), this field allows attempting to update it. The effect and accepted values might be specific.

title: Update a repository
description: Updates settings for an existing GitHub repository, such as name, description, visibility, merge strategies, and security configurations.

required.name: repo
required.description: ACTUAL name of an existing repository, without the `.git` extension (not case-sensitive). MUST be a real repository that exists and is accessible - placeholder values like 'your-repo-name' will cause 404 errors.

required.name: owner
required.description: ACTUAL GitHub username or organization name that owns the repository (not case-sensitive). MUST be a real, existing account - placeholder values like 'your-username' will cause 404 errors.

optional.name: name
optional.description: New name for the repository (not case-sensitive).

optional.name: private
optional.description: Whether the repository is private. IMPORTANT: Public forks cannot be made private - this is a GitHub platform restriction. Changing visibility may also be restricted by organization policies.

optional.name: archived
optional.description: Archives the repository (making it read-only) or unarchives it.

optional.name: has_wiki
optional.description: Enables the GitHub Wiki.

optional.name: homepage
optional.description: URL of the project's homepage.

optional.name: has_issues
optional.description: Enables GitHub Issues for this repository.

optional.name: visibility
optional.description: Repository visibility. IMPORTANT: Public forks cannot be made private - this is a GitHub platform restriction.

optional.name: description
optional.description: Brief summary of the repository.

optional.name: is_template
optional.description: Designates this repository as a template repository.

optional.name: has_projects
optional.description: Enables GitHub Projects. Note: Organization settings might override this and cause an error if projects are disabled organization-wide.

optional.name: allow_forking
optional.description: Allows private forks of this repository. IMPORTANT: This setting can ONLY be changed for organization-owned repositories. Attempting to set this for user-owned repositories will result in a 422 error. Omit this field if you don't want to change the forking setting.

optional.name: default_branch
optional.description: Name of the default branch.

optional.name: allow_auto_merge
optional.description: Enables auto-merge for pull requests.

optional.name: allow_merge_commit
optional.description: Allows merging pull requests via merge commits.

optional.name: allow_rebase_merge
optional.description: Allows rebase-merging pull requests.

optional.name: allow_squash_merge
optional.description: Allows squash-merging pull requests.

optional.name: merge_commit_title
optional.description: Default title for merge commits: 'PR_TITLE' or 'MERGE_MESSAGE'. CONSTRAINT: If set to 'PR_TITLE', merge_commit_message must be 'PR_BODY' or 'BLANK'. If set to 'MERGE_MESSAGE', merge_commit_message must be blank/unset.

optional.name: allow_update_branch
optional.description: Allows updating a pull request's head branch from the base branch if not strictly required for merging.

optional.name: merge_commit_message
optional.description: Default message for merge commits: 'PR_BODY', 'PR_TITLE', or 'BLANK'. CONSTRAINT: If merge_commit_title is 'PR_TITLE', this must be 'PR_BODY' or 'BLANK'. Cannot be set when merge_commit_title is 'MERGE_MESSAGE'.

optional.name: delete_branch_on_merge
optional.description: Automatically deletes head branches after merging pull requests.

optional.name: squash_merge_commit_title
optional.description: Default title for squash merge commits: 'PR_TITLE' or 'COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE'.

optional.name: squash_merge_commit_message
optional.description: Default message for squash merge commits: 'PR_BODY', 'COMMIT_MESSAGES', or 'BLANK'.

optional.name: web_commit_signoff_required
optional.description: Requires contributors to sign off on web-based commits.

optional.name: use_squash_pr_title_as_default
optional.description: DEPRECATED: Use `squash_merge_commit_title`. If true, squash merge commits use PR title; otherwise, commit message.

optional.name: security_and_analysis_secret_scanning_status
optional.description: Manages secret scanning. Set to 'enabled' or 'disabled'.

optional.name: security_and_analysis_advanced_security_status
optional.description: Manages GitHub Advanced Security. Set to 'enabled' or 'disabled'.

optional.name: security_analysis_secret_scanning_push_protection_status
optional.description: Manages secret scanning push protection. Set to 'enabled' or 'disabled'.

title: Update a repository invitation
description: Updates an active repository invitation to modify the invited user's permissions; the specified repository and invitation must exist.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository (e.g., a username or organization name). This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: invitation_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the repository invitation to be updated.

optional.name: permissions
optional.description: The new permissions to grant the invited user on the repository.

title: Update a repository ruleset
description: Updates an existing repository ruleset, identified by `ruleset_id` for a given repository, allowing partial updates to its configuration such as name, target, enforcement, bypass actors, conditions, and rules.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository. This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: ruleset_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the existing ruleset to be updated.

optional.name: name
optional.description: The new name for the ruleset.

optional.name: rules
optional.description: String representing rules to enforce. Each rule has a `type` and optional `parameters` (e.g., `[{'type': 'creation'}, {'type': 'pull_request', 'parameters': {'required_approving_review_count': 2}}]`). Accepts both JSON format with double quotes or Python list syntax with single quotes. Refer to GitHub API documentation for available rule types and their parameters.

optional.name: target
optional.description: The target of the ruleset (e.g., branch or tag).

optional.name: enforcement
optional.description: Specifies the enforcement level: `disabled` (ruleset is ignored), `active` (ruleset is enforced), or `evaluate` (allows testing rules before enforcement - GitHub Enterprise only).

optional.name: bypass_actors
optional.description: String representing actors that can bypass ruleset. Each actor specifies `actor_id`, `actor_type` (`RepositoryRole`, `Team`, `Integration`, `OrganizationAdmin`), and `bypass_mode` (`always`, `pull_request`). Accepts both JSON format with double quotes or Python list syntax with single quotes. Example: `[{'actor_id': 1, 'actor_type': 'RepositoryRole', 'bypass_mode': 'always'}]`.

optional.name: conditions_ref_name_exclude
optional.description: Ref names or patterns (fnmatch-style globs) to exclude. The ruleset will not apply if any of these patterns match.

optional.name: conditions_ref_name_include
optional.description: Ref names or patterns (fnmatch-style globs) to include for the ruleset to apply. `~DEFAULT_BRANCH` targets the default branch; `~ALL` targets all branches.

title: Update a repository variable
description: Updates the name and/or value of an existing GitHub Actions variable in a repository.

required.name: name
required.description: The current name of the Actions variable to update (path parameter). Variable names are case-insensitive and can only contain alphanumeric characters or underscores.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension; case-insensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository (e.g., GitHub username or organization name); case-insensitive.

optional.name: value
optional.description: The new value for the Actions variable. If omitted, the current value is retained. Must be a non-empty string if provided. You must provide either new_name or value (or both).

optional.name: new_name
optional.description: Optional new name for the variable. If provided, renames the variable. Can only contain alphanumeric characters or underscores; cannot start with GITHUB_ prefix.

title: Update a repository webhook
description: Updates the URL, content type, secret, SSL verification, events, or active status for an existing repository webhook, specified by `owner`, `repo`, and `hook_id`.

required.name: repo
required.description: Repository name, without the `.git` extension (not case-sensitive).

required.name: owner
required.description: Username or organization name of the repository owner (not case-sensitive).

required.name: hook_id
required.description: Unique identifier of the webhook (found in `X-GitHub-Hook-ID` header of a delivery).

optional.name: active
optional.description: Set `true` if active and sending notifications, `false` otherwise.

optional.name: events
optional.description: List of events to trigger the webhook. GitHub REPLACES the full event list when this is sent — omit (leave unset) to preserve the existing subscription. Use `add_events`/`remove_events` for incremental changes. See GitHub webhook event payloads docs for available event types.

optional.name: add_events
optional.description: Events to add to current subscriptions.

optional.name: config_url
optional.description: New URL for webhook payload delivery.

optional.name: remove_events
optional.description: Events to remove from current subscriptions.

optional.name: config_secret
optional.description: Optional secret for HMAC digest of delivery signature headers (see GitHub docs).

optional.name: config_content_type
optional.description: Media type for serializing payloads ('json' or 'form').

optional.name: config_insecure_ssl
optional.description: Set to '1' to disable SSL verification (insecure), '0' to enable.

title: Update a team
description: Updates a team's settings (e.g., name, description, privacy, parent team) within a GitHub organization, identified by its slug and organization name.

required.name: org
required.description: The organization's name (case-insensitive). This is a required path parameter.

required.name: team_slug
required.description: The team's unique slug identifier (typically URL-friendly version of team name). This is a required path parameter.

optional.name: name
optional.description: New display name for the team.

optional.name: privacy
optional.description:
The desired privacy level for the team. Editing teams without specifying this parameter leaves `privacy` intact. When a team is nested, the `privacy` for parent teams cannot be `secret`.
  - For a non-nested team:
    - `secret`: Visible only to organization owners and members of this team.
    - `closed`: Visible to all members of this organization.
    - `public`: Visible to all members of this organization (equivalent to `closed`).
  - For a parent or child team:
    - `closed`: Visible to all members of this organization.
    - `public`: Visible to all members of this organization (equivalent to `closed`).

optional.name: permission
optional.description: **Deprecated**. Default permission (pull, push, or admin) for new repositories added to this team. This may be removed in future versions.

optional.name: description
optional.description: New team description; an empty string clears the existing description.

optional.name: parent_team_id
optional.description: The unique identifier (ID) of an existing team to set as this team's parent. This establishes a nested team structure. To remove an existing parent team relationship and make this a top-level team, explicitly pass `null` for this field (e.g., by setting this parameter to Python `None`). If this parameter is not provided in the request, the current parent team, if any, remains unchanged.

optional.name: notification_setting
optional.description:
The notification setting the team has chosen. Editing teams without specifying this parameter leaves `notification_setting` intact.
  - `notifications_enabled`: Team members receive notifications when the team is @mentioned.
  - `notifications_disabled`: No one receives notifications for team @mentions.

title: Update branch protection
description: Updates the protection settings for an existing branch in a repository, which must not contain wildcard characters.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension (not case-sensitive).

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository (not case-sensitive).

required.name: branch
required.description: Name of the branch to protect; wildcard characters are not allowed (use GraphQL API for wildcard support).

optional.name: lock_branch
optional.description: If `True`, sets the branch to read-only, preventing pushes.

optional.name: enforce_admins
optional.description: Enforces configured restrictions for repository administrators. Set to `True` to enforce for admins, or `None`/`null` to disable.

optional.name: allow_deletions
optional.description: Allows deletion of the protected branch.

optional.name: block_creations
optional.description: If `True`, push restrictions also apply to creating matching new branches, unless pusher has explicit push access.

optional.name: allow_force_pushes
optional.description: Permits force pushes to the protected branch. Set to `True` to allow, `None`/`null` to block.

optional.name: allow_fork_syncing
optional.description: Allows users to pull upstream changes into their fork when the branch is locked.

optional.name: restrictions_apps
optional.description: App `slug`s with push access. Cannot be used with `restrictions_users` or `restrictions_teams`. Empty list removes all.

optional.name: restrictions_teams
optional.description: Team `slug`s with push access. Cannot be used with `restrictions_apps` or `restrictions_users`. Empty list removes all.

optional.name: restrictions_users
optional.description: User `login`s with push access. Cannot be used with `restrictions_apps` or `restrictions_teams`. Empty list removes all.

optional.name: required_linear_history
optional.description: Enforces linear commit history by preventing merge commits. Repository must allow squash or rebase merging.

optional.name: required_status_checks_checks
optional.description: List of status checks required to merge. Each check object needs a `context` string and optionally an `app_id` integer. **Mutually exclusive with `contexts`** - use one or the other, not both.

optional.name: required_status_checks_strict
optional.description: Require branches to be up to date with the base branch before merging; if `True`, merges are blocked if the head branch is behind the base branch.

optional.name: required_conversation_resolution
optional.description: Requires all conversations on code to be resolved before merging a pull request.

optional.name: required_status_checks_contexts
optional.description: **Deprecated**: List of status check contexts required to merge. If set by a GitHub App, future checks must come from that app. Use `checks` for finer control. **Mutually exclusive with `checks`** - use one or the other, not both.

optional.name: required_pull_request_reviews_dismiss_stale_reviews
optional.description: If `True`, new commits dismiss previous review approvals on a pull request branch.

optional.name: required_pull_request_reviews_approving_review_count
optional.description: Number of approving reviews (0-6) required to merge a pull request; 0 disables.

optional.name: required_pull_request_reviews_bypass_allowances_apps
optional.description: App `slug`s allowed to bypass pull request requirements. Empty list removes all.

optional.name: required_pull_request_reviews_bypass_allowances_teams
optional.description: Team `slug`s allowed to bypass pull request requirements. Empty list removes all.

optional.name: required_pull_request_reviews_bypass_allowances_users
optional.description: User `login`s allowed to bypass pull request requirements. Empty list removes all.

optional.name: required_pull_request_reviews_dismiss_restrictions_apps
optional.description: App `slug`s allowed to dismiss pull request reviews. Empty list removes all.

optional.name: required_pull_request_reviews_dismiss_restrictions_teams
optional.description: Team `slug`s allowed to dismiss pull request reviews. Empty list removes all.

optional.name: required_pull_request_reviews_dismiss_restrictions_users
optional.description: User `login`s allowed to dismiss pull request reviews. Empty list removes all.

optional.name: required_pull_request_reviews_require_code_owner_reviews
optional.description: If `True`, pull requests affecting files with code owners must be reviewed by them.

optional.name: required_pull_request_reviews_require_last_push_approval
optional.description: If `True`, the most recent push must be approved by someone other than the pusher.

title: Update a code scanning default setup configuration
description: Updates the default setup configuration for code scanning in a repository; GitHub Advanced Security must be enabled for the repository.

required.name: repo
required.description: Repository name (case-insensitive, without `.git` extension).

required.name: owner
required.description: Account owner of the repository (case-insensitive).

optional.name: state
optional.description: Specifies whether to enable ('configured') or disable ('not-configured') code scanning default setup.

optional.name: languages
optional.description: CodeQL languages for analysis; if omitted, all supported repository languages are analyzed.

optional.name: query_suite
optional.description: CodeQL query suite to be used ('default' for curated, 'extended' for comprehensive queries).

optional.name: runner_type
optional.description: Type of runner to use for code scanning. 'standard' uses GitHub-hosted runners, 'labeled' uses self-hosted runners with a specific label, 'not_set' resets to default.

optional.name: runner_label
optional.description: Label of the self-hosted runner to use when runner_type is 'labeled'. Ignored when runner_type is 'standard'.

title: Update a codespace for the authenticated user
description: Updates an existing GitHub Codespace's machine type, display name, or recent folders for the authenticated user; machine type changes take effect on the next start.

required.name: codespace_name
required.description: The unique name of the codespace to be updated (e.g., 'octocat-codespace-githu-org-name-abcdef12').

optional.name: machine
optional.description: Target machine type for the codespace; must be valid and available for the user or organization.

optional.name: display_name
optional.description: New display name for the codespace.

optional.name: recent_folders
optional.description: Up to three recently opened folder paths (e.g., '/workspaces/project/src') to suggest which folder to load upon opening.

title: Update issue type
description: Update an existing issue type for a GitHub organization. Requires the authenticated user to be an organization administrator. OAuth tokens need admin:org scope.

required.name: org
required.description: The organization name (case-insensitive).

required.name: name
required.description: The name of the issue type.

required.name: is_enabled
required.description: Whether the issue type is enabled at the organization level.

required.name: issue_type_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the issue type to update.

optional.name: color
optional.description: The color of the issue type.

optional.name: description
optional.description: A short description of the issue type.

title: Update a webhook configuration for an organization
description: Updates the configuration (URL, content type, secret, SSL verification) for an existing webhook within a specified organization.

required.name: org
required.description: The organization name (not case-sensitive).

required.name: hook_id
required.description: Unique identifier of the webhook (from `X-GitHub-Hook-ID` header of a delivery).

optional.name: url
optional.description: The URL to which the webhook payloads will be delivered.

optional.name: secret
optional.description: Optional secret for HMAC hex digest in delivery signature headers.

optional.name: content_type
optional.description: Media type for serializing payloads (`json` or `form`). Defaults to `form`.

optional.name: insecure_ssl
optional.description: Set to `1` to disable SSL certificate verification for the webhook URL, or `0` to enable. Defaults to `0`.

title: Update a review for a pull request
description: Updates the body text of an existing pull request review.

required.name: body
required.description: The new body text for the pull request review. This will replace the existing review body.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This is case-insensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The username of the account that owns the repository. This is case-insensitive.

required.name: review_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the pull request review to be updated.

required.name: pull_number
required.description: The number that uniquely identifies the pull request within the repository.

title: Update a review comment for a pull request
description: Updates the body of an existing review comment on a pull request.

required.name: body
required.description: The new text of the pull request review comment. Must be a non-empty string.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This field is not case-sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The username or organization name that owns the repository. This field is not case-sensitive.

required.name: comment_id
required.description: The unique identifier of the pull request review comment to be updated.

title: Update pull request review protection
description: Updates pull request review protection settings (e.g., required approvals, review dismissal, bypass allowances) for a branch; branch protection features must be available for the repository.

required.name: repo
required.description: Repository name, without the `.git` extension (case-insensitive).

required.name: owner
required.description: Account owner of the repository (case-insensitive).

required.name: branch
required.description: Branch name for protection rules (no wildcards; use GraphQL API for wildcards).

optional.name: dismiss_stale_reviews
optional.description: If `true`, new commits dismiss previous approving reviews; `false` keeps approvals valid.

optional.name: require_code_owner_reviews
optional.description: If `true`, pull requests affecting files with code owners require their review. See [about code owners](https://docs.github.com/articles/about-code-owners/).

optional.name: require_last_push_approval
optional.description: If `true`, the most recent push requires approval by someone other than the pusher (GitHub Enterprise feature).

optional.name: dismissal_restrictions_apps
optional.description: App `slug`s permitted to dismiss pull request reviews. Empty list removes restrictions.

optional.name: dismissal_restrictions_teams
optional.description: Team `slug`s permitted to dismiss pull request reviews. Empty list removes restrictions.

optional.name: dismissal_restrictions_users
optional.description: User `login`s permitted to dismiss pull request reviews. Empty list removes restrictions.

optional.name: required_approving_review_count
optional.description: Number of approving reviews (1-6) required for merging; 0 to disable.

optional.name: bypass_pull_request_allowances_apps
optional.description: App `slug`s allowed to bypass pull request requirements. Empty list removes allowances.

optional.name: bypass_pull_request_allowances_teams
optional.description: Team `slug`s allowed to bypass pull request requirements. Empty list removes allowances.

optional.name: bypass_pull_request_allowances_users
optional.description: User `login`s allowed to bypass pull request requirements. Empty list removes allowances.

title: Update repository preferences for check suites
description: Updates repository preferences for automatic Check Suite creation on code pushes, allowing configuration for specific GitHub Apps that must be installed on the repository with `checks:write` permission.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository (e.g., username or organization). The name is not case sensitive.

optional.name: auto_trigger_checks
optional.description: A list of preference objects as a JSON string for configuring automatic CheckSuite creation for specific GitHub Apps. Each object in the list must contain an `app_id` (integer: the ID of the GitHub App) and a `setting` (boolean: `true` to enable automatic triggers for that app on code push, `false` to disable). Example: '[{"app_id": 12345, "setting": true}]'

title: Update a webhook configuration for a repository
description: Updates the configuration (e.g., payload URL, content type, secret, SSL verification) for an existing webhook in a specified repository.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension (not case-sensitive).

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository (not case-sensitive).

required.name: hook_id
required.description: Unique identifier of the webhook, typically found in the `X-GitHub-Hook-ID` header of a webhook delivery.

optional.name: url
optional.description: The URL to which webhook payloads will be delivered.

optional.name: secret
optional.description: Optional secret for generating an HMAC hex digest of the payload, included in the `X-Hub-Signature-256` header to verify authenticity.

optional.name: content_type
optional.description: Media type for payload serialization (e.g., `json`, `form`). GitHub defaults to `form` if this field is not provided.

optional.name: insecure_ssl
optional.description: Specifies SSL certificate verification: '0' for enabled (default behavior if omitted), '1' for disabled (not recommended).

title: Update resource access with tokens
description: Revokes organization access for the personal access tokens identified by `pat_ids`; this action must be performed by a GitHub App, and `pat_ids` must be valid and associated with the organization. AUTHENTICATION REQUIREMENT: This endpoint requires GitHub App authentication with 'Personal access tokens' organization permissions (write). Standard personal access tokens CANNOT use this endpoint. The GitHub App must also have access to the organization.

required.name: org
required.description: Organization name (case-insensitive).

required.name: action
required.description: Operation to perform on the fine-grained personal access tokens, resulting in removal of their access.

required.name: pat_ids
required.description: Fine-grained personal access token IDs for which access will be revoked.

title: Update status check protection
description: Updates required status checks for a branch, optionally requiring it to be up-to-date before merging.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This name is not case-sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository. This name is not case-sensitive.

required.name: branch
required.description: The name of the branch (required, cannot be null or empty). Wildcard characters are not allowed. To use wildcard characters in branch names, please use the GraphQL API.

optional.name: checks
optional.description: A list of status checks to require in order to merge into this branch. Each check object should have a `context` (string) and an optional `app_id` (integer). Example: `[{"context": "continuous-integration/jenkins", "app_id": 12345}]`

optional.name: strict
optional.description: Specifies whether to require branches to be up to date before merging.

optional.name: contexts
optional.description: **Deprecated**: A list of status checks to require in order to merge into this branch. If any of these checks were recently set by a particular GitHub App, they will be required to come from that app in the future for the branch to merge. For more fine-grained control, use `checks` instead of `contexts`. Can be provided as a single string or a list of strings.

title: Update Subscription
description: Tool to update notification subscription state for issues, pull requests, or discussions. Use when you need to subscribe, unsubscribe, or ignore notifications for a specific GitHub item.

required.name: state
required.description: The new subscription state. SUBSCRIBED: receive notifications for all activity. UNSUBSCRIBED: stop receiving notifications. IGNORED: never receive notifications even when mentioned.

required.name: subscribable_id
required.description: The Node ID of the subscribable object (issue, pull request, discussion, etc.) to modify. This is a global GraphQL ID, not a repository-local number.

optional.name: client_mutation_id
optional.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation. Used for tracking and deduplication.

title: Update the authenticated user
description: Updates the authenticated user's GitHub profile; a new public email must be verified, and existing private emails remain private even if specified.

optional.name: bio
optional.description: The new short biography for the user. Provide `null` to clear the existing bio.

optional.name: blog
optional.description: The new URL for the user's blog. Provide `null` to clear the existing blog URL. For example, 'https://github.blog'.

optional.name: name
optional.description: The new full name for the user. For example, 'Mona Lisa Octocat'.

optional.name: email
optional.description: The user's new publicly visible email address. This email must be verified on the user's GitHub account. If the provided email is not verified or not set to public, the update for this field might be ignored.

optional.name: company
optional.description: The new company affiliation for the user. Provide `null` to clear the existing company. For example, 'GitHub'.

optional.name: hireable
optional.description: Indicates whether the user is available for hire. Set to `true` if available, or `false` if not.

optional.name: location
optional.description: The new geographical location of the user. Provide `null` to clear the existing location. For example, 'San Francisco'.

optional.name: twitter_username
optional.description: The user's new Twitter username (without the leading '@'). Provide `null` to clear the existing Twitter username. For example, 'github'.

title: Revoke Token Organization Access
description: Revokes a fine-grained personal access token's access to an organization. IMPORTANT: This endpoint can ONLY be called by GitHub Apps with 'Personal access tokens' organization permissions (write). Personal access tokens (PATs) cannot use this endpoint. Use GITHUB_LIST_ORG_RESOURCE_ACCESS_TOKENS to get valid pat_id values for tokens that have access to your organization.

required.name: org
required.description: The organization name (case-insensitive). The authenticated GitHub App must have 'Personal access tokens' organization permissions (write) for this organization.

required.name: pat_id
required.description: The unique numeric identifier of the fine-grained personal access token to revoke. Obtain this from the GITHUB_LIST_ORG_RESOURCE_ACCESS_TOKENS action.

optional.name: action
optional.description: The action to perform. Currently only 'revoke' is supported, which removes the token's access to the organization.

title: Update User List
description: Tool to update an existing GitHub user list. Use when you need to modify the name, description, or privacy settings of a user list.

required.name: list_id
required.description: The unique ID of the user list to update. This is the GraphQL node ID (e.g., 'UL_kwDOCNqc1s4AbuJ8').

optional.name: name
optional.description: The new name for the user list. Only provide if you want to change the name.

optional.name: is_private
optional.description: Whether the list should be private. Set to true to make private, false to make public. Only provide if you want to change visibility.

optional.name: description
optional.description: The new description for the user list. Only provide if you want to change the description.

optional.name: client_mutation_id
optional.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation. Used for idempotency and tracking.

title: Update user lists for item
description: Tool to update which of the viewer's lists an item belongs to on GitHub. Use when you need to add an item (repository, issue, pull request, etc.) to specific user lists or move it between lists.

required.name: item_id
required.description: The global node ID of the item to add to the lists (e.g., 'R_kgDOKl1DMA' for a repository). This is the GraphQL global identifier returned by GitHub's API.

required.name: list_ids
required.description: The list of user list IDs that this item should belong to. The item will be added to these lists and removed from any other lists it previously belonged to.

optional.name: client_mutation_id
optional.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation. This can be used to track the request.

optional.name: suggested_list_ids
optional.description: Optional list of suggested list IDs to create and add this item to. These lists will be created if they don't exist.

title: Update Project V2 Item for User
description: Tool to update a field value for an item in a user's GitHub ProjectV2. Use when you need to modify a field value of an existing project item.

required.name: value
required.description: The value to set. Use {'text': 'value'} for text fields, {'number': 123} for number fields, {'singleSelectOptionId': 'option_id'} for single select, {'date': '2024-01-01'} for date fields, {'iterationId': 'iteration_id'} for iteration fields.

required.name: item_id
required.description: The global node ID of the project item to update (e.g., 'PVTI_lAHOCNqc1s4BN3oqzgldG_w').

required.name: field_id
required.description: The global node ID of the field to update (e.g., 'PVTSSF_lAHOCNqc1s4BN3oqzg8vTnA').

required.name: project_id
required.description: The global node ID of the Project (e.g., 'PVT_kwHOCNqc1s4BN3oq').

title: Change User Status
description: Tool to update your status on GitHub. Use when you need to set or clear your GitHub profile status with an emoji, message, and availability indicator.

optional.name: emoji
optional.description: The emoji to represent your status. Can either be a native Unicode emoji or an emoji name with colons, e.g., :rocket:, :smiley:. If omitted, any existing emoji will be cleared.

optional.name: message
optional.description: A short description of your current status. Maximum 80 characters. If omitted, any existing message will be cleared.

optional.name: expires_at
optional.description: If set, the user status will not be shown after this date. Must be a valid ISO 8601 datetime string (e.g., 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z). If omitted, the status will persist indefinitely.

optional.name: organization_id
optional.description: The global node ID of the organization whose members will be allowed to see the status. If omitted, the status will be publicly visible to everyone. Use this to limit status visibility to organization members only.

optional.name: client_mutation_id
optional.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation. This value will be returned in the response and can be used for request tracking or idempotency.

optional.name: limited_availability
optional.description: Whether this status should indicate you are not fully available on GitHub (e.g., you are away or busy). When true, shows a busy indicator. Defaults to false if omitted.

title: Upload a release asset
description: Tool to upload a binary asset to an existing GitHub release. Use when you need to attach files like installers or backups to a release programmatically.

required.name: repo
required.description: Repository name without the .git extension; not case sensitive.

required.name: asset
required.description: Binary file to upload as the release asset.

required.name: owner
required.description: Account owner of the repository; not case sensitive.

required.name: release_id
required.description: Unique identifier of the release. The release must have a valid upload URL (i.e., not already finalized without one). Asset size must not exceed 2 GB.

required.name: content_type
required.description: Media type of the asset, for example 'application/zip'.

optional.name: label
optional.description: Short description for the asset; displayed instead of filename.

title: Upload an analysis as sarif data
description: Uploads a gzipped and Base64 encoded SARIF file to a GitHub repository for a specific commit and reference; use `checkout_uri` if SARIF paths are absolute.

required.name: ref
required.description: The full Git reference for the analysis, formatted as `refs/heads/<branch name>`, `refs/tags/<tag>`, `refs/pull/<number>/merge`, or `refs/pull/<number>/head`.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This is case-insensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository. This is case-insensitive.

required.name: sarif
required.description: A Base64 encoded string of a gzipped SARIF file. For more information, see '[SARIF support for code scanning](https://docs.github.com/code-security/secure-coding/sarif-support-for-code-scanning)'.

required.name: commit_sha
required.description: The SHA of the commit to which the analysis you are uploading relates. Must be a 40-character Git SHA.

optional.name: validate
optional.description: Specifies whether the uploaded SARIF file should be validated against the code scanning specifications. This is useful for integrators to ensure their SARIF files are correctly processed and rendered by GitHub.

optional.name: tool_name
optional.description: Name of the tool that generated the analysis. GitHub defaults this to "API" if omitted. A tool GUID in the SARIF can be used for filtering alerts.

optional.name: started_at
optional.description: The timestamp indicating when the analysis run began, in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

optional.name: checkout_uri
optional.description: The base URI of the checkout directory as it appears in the SARIF file. This property is used to convert absolute file paths to relative paths, enabling alerts to be correctly mapped to their location in the repository.

title: Create or update repository custom property values
description: Creates or updates up to 30 custom property values for a repository; custom properties must be predefined at the organization or repository level, and setting a property's value to `null` removes it.

required.name: repo
required.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: owner
required.description: The account owner of the repository. This name is not case sensitive.

required.name: properties
required.description: A list of custom property objects as a JSON string to create or update for the repository. Each object in the list must contain `property_name` (string identifying the custom property) and `value` (the value for the property, which can be a string, number, or a single-select option, matching the property's defined type). Example: '[{"property_name": "environment", "value": "production"}]'

title: Validate credential
description: Validates GitHub API credentials by checking if they can successfully authenticate. Use this action when you need to verify that API credentials are valid and have not expired or been revoked. Returns whether the credentials are valid along with the authenticated user's username.

title: Verify dev container permissions accepted
description: Verifies if the authenticated user has accepted permissions for a specific devcontainer configuration in a repository, typically to ensure awareness before a codespace is created or used.

required.name: ref
required.description: Git reference (branch, tag, or commit SHA) for the devcontainer configuration.

required.name: repo
required.description: Repository name, without `.git` extension (case-insensitive).

required.name: owner
required.description: Username of the repository owner (case-insensitive).

required.name: devcontainer_path
required.description: Path to the `devcontainer.json` file in the repository.

title: Who Am I
description: Return the identity (login, name) of the connected GitHub account.
